title: Quality Analyst (Programming & Technology Expert)
description:
**Department:**
Technology / Quality Assurance

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Working Hours:**
8 Hours per Day, 5 Days per Week

**Experience:**
2+ Years

**Qualification:**
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

**About the Role**

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Programming & Technology Expert to evaluate and qualify freelancers across various technology-related categories. The candidate will be responsible for reviewing technical portfolios, live projects, websites, mobile applications, and other work samples to assess their quality, functionality, authenticity, and professional standards.

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in at least one major technology domain, such as Web Development, Software Development, Mobile App Development, AI Development, or Quality Assurance, along with a general understanding of modern technologies and development practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Evaluation**

* Review freelancer portfolios, live websites, software applications, and technical projects.
* Assess technical quality, functionality, usability, complexity, and overall professional execution.
* Evaluate applicants across technology categories, including:
* Website Development & Maintenance
* Software & Mobile Application Development
* AI Development, Chatbots & Automation
* Cloud Computing & DevOps
* Game Development
* Cybersecurity & Blockchain
* Other Programming & Technology Services
* Verify the authenticity and credibility of submitted work samples and project claims.
* Approve or reject applications based on established evaluation guidelines.

**2. Quality Assurance & Reporting**

* Identify technical weaknesses and distinguish basic work from professional-quality implementations.
* Prepare clear, structured evaluation reports with evidence-based feedback.
* Maintain consistency, accuracy, and fairness throughout the assessment process.
* Collaborate with internal teams and subject-matter experts when specialized technical knowledge is required.
* Follow defined quality standards and evaluation procedures.

**3. Research & Continuous Learning**

* Stay updated on emerging technologies, programming practices, and industry trends.
* Develop an understanding of new tools, platforms, and technology services.
* Apply AI-assisted tools and relevant resources to support technical evaluations where appropriate.
* Improve evaluation methods to maintain high-quality assessment standards.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in at least one relevant technology domain.
* Strong technical knowledge of at least one major programming or technology discipline.
* General understanding of software development lifecycles, technical workflows, and quality standards.
* Ability to assess websites, applications, portfolios, and technical project deliverables.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
* Good written English communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to make objective decisions based on technical evidence and predefined criteria.
* Ability to manage multiple evaluations while maintaining accuracy and consistency.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in software development, technical QA, code review, or technical assessment.
* Familiarity with AI tools, automation platforms, and modern development technologies.
* Experience evaluating technical professionals or working with freelancer marketplaces.
* Ability to learn new technologies and apply structured assessment guidelines.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to work independently.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with a global freelancer evaluation and quality assurance ecosystem.
* Gain exposure to diverse technology projects and international professionals.
* Develop technical assessment skills across multiple technology domains.
* Enjoy continuous learning and professional growth opportunities.
* Work in a flexible, collaborative environment that encourages ownership, innovation, and quality.
* Working Schedule: 8 Hours per Day | 5 Days per Week

**Who Should Apply?**

Professionals with practical experience in software development, web development, mobile applications, AI, QA, or other technology-related fields who are interested in evaluating technical work, maintaining quality standards, and identifying skilled professionals.

About Not Rocket Science

Not Rocket Science (NRS) makes ready-to-drink protein beverages — Protein Water, Protein Punch and new functional drinks — built to taste like drinks first, not supplements. We're an Ahmedabad-based brand under Nutrifuture Solutions LLP, sold across our website, Amazon, quick commerce and general trade. Product and formulation sit at the centre of the company.

The role

You'll be the quality and technical layer between our raw materials and the bottle on the shelf. Half your time goes to quality — checking what comes in, what gets produced and what gets printed on the label. The other half supports purchase and production planning alongside the Head of Purchase & Manufacturing. It's a hands-on role for someone who wants to learn beverage manufacturing end to end, fast.

What you'll do

**Incoming quality**

* Review Certificates of Analysis for every incoming lot of protein, flavours, sweeteners and packaging; flag deviations before material is released
* Maintain approved-supplier specs and track supplier performance over time
* Arrange third-party lab testing when a lot or a claim needs verification

**Production quality**

* Attend trial and production runs at manufacturing partners; verify batch parameters against spec (pH, Brix, fill volume, sealing, temperature)
* Maintain batch records, retained samples and a shelf-life tracker for every SKU
* Investigate and document consumer or trade complaints back to batch level

**Labelling and regulatory**

* Check every pack artwork change against FSSAI labelling and nutrition-declaration requirements before it goes to print
* Keep FSSAI licences, product approvals and test reports current and organised
* Track regulatory updates that affect our ingredients, claims or labels

**Purchase and planning support**

* Raise and follow up purchase orders for raw and packaging material
* Track inventory of key inputs against the production plan; flag shortfalls early
* Coordinate dispatch of materials to manufacturing partners

**New product support**

* Help run bench trials, sensory panels and stability studies for new SKUs
* Document formulation changes and their test results

What we're looking for

**Must-haves**

* B.Tech Food Technology or M.Sc Food Science / Food Technology
* Working knowledge of FSSAI regulations, especially labelling and nutrition declarations
* Comfort with basic lab measurements — pH, Brix, moisture, titratable acidity
* Meticulous with records: you notice when a number on a CoA doesn't match the spec
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
* Willing to travel to manufacturing partners regularly, sometimes at short notice
* Clear written and spoken English and Gujarati or Hindi

**Nice-to-haves**

* Internship or work experience in a beverage, dairy or nutraceutical plant
* Exposure to hot-fill, aseptic or retort processing
* Familiarity with whey or plant protein ingredients
* Some purchase or vendor-coordination experience

Why join

* You'll see the full journey of a beverage — raw material, formulation, trial, production, label, shelf — in your first six months
* Direct exposure to R&D: new SKUs are developed in-house, and you'll work on them from bench trial to launch
* A small team where your quality calls are acted on, not filed away
* Room to grow into a Quality & Regulatory lead role as manufacturing scales

title: Strategic Initiatives Associate
description:
Strategic Initiatives Associate

SVECTOR | Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-site) | Full-time | Monday to Saturday

Experience: 0–4 years. Exceptional fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

Reports to: Founder-CEO

About SVECTOR

SVECTOR is a technology company building intelligence infrastructure for enterprises and institutions. We develop software systems that help organizations understand complex information, improve decision-making and execute critical business processes. Our initiatives span enterprise intelligence, talent and leadership decision systems, healthcare, industrial technology, financial intelligence and defensive intelligence.

We work on problems where technology must do more than generate information. It must help people understand what is happening, decide what to do and turn decisions into measurable outcomes.

About the Role

We are hiring a Strategic Initiatives Associate to work closely with company leadership on selected product, technology and business initiatives. This is an early-career role for someone curious, capable and dependable who wants to understand how a technology business runs while taking direct responsibility for meaningful work.

You will take assigned objectives, work out a practical approach, bring the right people together and carry the work through to a verified result. You will work across engineering, product and business teams on things like investigating a product issue, understanding a customer requirement, preparing a business analysis, coordinating a pilot or moving an initiative from planning into execution.

This is not a role defined by attending meetings, preparing presentations or passing instructions between departments. The goal is to contribute directly to work that produces results. Experience in an identical role is not required.

What You Will Do

Project execution

• Understand the objective, constraints and importance of each assigned initiative.

• Break objectives into activities, deliverables, owners and milestones.

• Coordinate with engineering, product and business stakeholders.

• Spot delays, dependencies and gaps early, and resolve blockers within your authority.

• Follow up on commitments and keep progress, pending actions and open issues visible.

• Check completed work against its original requirements.

• Prepare short progress summaries and flag decisions that need leadership attention.

You are expected to understand the work you coordinate. Collecting updates or maintaining a tracker without understanding the problem is not enough.

Product and technical-business work

• Use SVECTOR's software products to understand their real capabilities and limits.

• Understand customer workflows and the problems customers expect the product to solve.

• Investigate reported issues and tell defects apart from unclear requirements and new feature requests.

• Turn business and customer needs into clear problem statements, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Work with engineers to understand constraints, dependencies and possible approaches.

• Support demos, testing, customer pilots and implementation, and confirm delivered work meets the requirement.

You are not being hired as a full-time software developer, but strong technical literacy matters. You should be comfortable with concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations and data flows, and willing to learn what you do not yet know.

Research and analysis

• Research companies, industries, technologies and business opportunities.

• Compare competitors, products, technical approaches and tools.

• Study enterprise customers and the environments they operate in.

• Review reports, specifications and original source material.

• Prepare decision briefs and recommendations that state what is known, what the evidence is, what remains uncertain and what to do next.

We expect you to go beyond the first search result, verify important claims, check numbers and explain your reasoning. We value independent thinking over long documents full of generic observations.

Business and customer initiatives

• Research prospective customers and decision-makers, and prepare background for key discussions.

• Support demos, discovery calls and technical-business presentations.

• Turn customer feedback into specific product or business actions.

• Help with proposals and solution briefs, and coordinate pilot follow-ups.

• Join customer meetings and speak with external stakeholders when authorized.

There is no individual sales quota. Pricing, contracts and financial commitments stay subject to leadership approval.

Leadership support and AI tools

• Prepare briefing notes and short memos for important discussions.

• Record decisions, commitments and open questions, and keep actions tied to owners.

• Use AI tools and modern software for research, document analysis and repetitive workflows, and check their output against reliable sources.

Using AI does not remove your responsibility to understand your own work. An unverified AI-generated document that you cannot explain is not an acceptable deliverable. You will also follow company rules on confidential information and data handling.

Who You Are

• Curious: you want to understand a hard problem, not avoid it.

• Accountable: a task is done when there is an outcome, not when you have sent a message. You are honest about obstacles and mistakes.

• Structured: you break problems down, test assumptions and reach reasoned conclusions, even under uncertainty.

• Clear communicator: excellent written and spoken English, with precise emails, briefs and summaries.

• Technically curious: you enjoy learning how software is built and used. Coding experience helps but is not required.

• Reliable: you respect deadlines and confidentiality, know when you need approval, and accept feedback well.

Qualifications

• 0–4 years of relevant experience. Internships, independent projects, research, entrepreneurship or full-time work all count.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, AI, Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Management or a related field is preferred. Other backgrounds are considered where projects show the capability. No MBA required.

• Experience in product operations, business analysis, technical consulting, software development, strategic research or project execution is relevant.

We care about work you have actually completed: a product or technical project, an internship where you solved a real problem, a research assignment with a defensible conclusion, or an initiative where you took responsibility beyond your assigned work. Tell us your own contribution, the decisions you made and the results.

This role is not an administrative or personal-assistant job, a software engineering job focused on production code, a pure consulting role or a senior management position. It is an execution-oriented role centered on product understanding, research, problem-solving and completing assigned initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

• First 30 days: learn the products, workflows and priorities, and complete initial research and product assignments accurately.

• Days 31–60: own a defined initiative, prepare an execution approach and keep progress visible.

• Days 61–90: carry an initiative to an agreed result or a documented handover.

Hiring Process

1. Application review

2. Initial discussion

3. Practical assessment: a realistic research, product or business task. AI tools may be used where permitted, but you must be able to explain and verify your work.

4. Leadership interview

5. Offer discussion: responsibilities, compensation, schedule and joining date are confirmed before a written offer.

Working Arrangements

Full-time, on-site in Ahmedabad, Monday to Saturday. Schedule, compensation and joining terms are confirmed before a formal offer. If anything about the role or location does not match your expectations, please raise it in the first discussion.

How to Apply

Send your resume with a short note covering:

1. Your strongest example of ownership: what you did, which decisions you made and what happened.

2. Why you are interested in technology, research, product understanding and business execution.

3. Your current location, availability to work full-time on-site in Ahmedabad and earliest joining date.

Links to projects, GitHub, portfolios or research are welcome. Please skip the generic statements.

title: Quality Management Executive
description:
Job Description – Head, Quality Management Systems (QMS)

Company: Eastface Packaging – A Division of Sahitya Mudranalaya Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Department: Quality

Designation: Head – Quality Management Systems (QMS)

Reporting To: Plant Head / Management

Industry: Printing & Packaging – Folding Cartons / Mono Cartons

Experience - Minimum 2 - 3 years

**Salary - 40-45k per month

For applications send cv on codasyncs.hrbp1@gmail.com with a request to fix an appointment**

Role Purpose

The QMS Head will be responsible for developing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving the Quality Management System at Eastface Packaging.

The role will ensure that manufacturing operations, documentation, quality controls, hygiene systems, traceability, customer requirements, and regulatory processes comply with applicable standards including ISO, BRCGS Packaging Materials, GMP, FSC and customer-specific requirements.

The QMS Head will act as the key owner of quality-system compliance and will coordinate closely with Production, Quality Control, Stores, Purchase, Maintenance, HR, Prepress and senior management.

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Management System

\* Develop, implement and maintain the company’s Quality Management System.

\* Establish and maintain SOPs, work instructions, policies, formats, registers and quality records.

\* Ensure effective document control and revision control across departments.

\* Ensure all processes are performed according to approved procedures and specifications.

\* Periodically review the effectiveness of the QMS and recommend improvements.

\* Ensure proper implementation of change-control procedures.

2. BRCGS & Certification Management

\* Lead implementation and maintenance of BRCGS Packaging Materials certification requirements.

\* Ensure continuous readiness for announced and unannounced audits.

\* Coordinate ISO, BRCGS, FSC and other certification audits.

\* Conduct regular gap assessments against applicable certification standards.

\* Ensure corrective actions arising from certification audits are completed within defined timelines.

\* Maintain records and evidence required for certification and surveillance audits.

3. Internal Audits

\* Develop the annual internal-audit schedule.

\* Conduct and coordinate internal audits across all departments.

\* Identify non-conformities, observations and opportunities for improvement.

\* Issue audit reports and monitor corrective and preventive actions.

\* Verify effectiveness of CAPA implementation.

\* Escalate recurring or critical non-conformities to management.

4. CAPA & Root Cause Analysis

\* Manage the company’s Corrective and Preventive Action system.

\* Lead root-cause analysis for:

\* Customer complaints

\* Internal quality failures

\* Audit non-conformities

\* Process deviations

\* Repeated production defects

\* Use structured problem-solving techniques such as:

\* 5 Why Analysis

\* Fishbone / Ishikawa Analysis

\* Pareto Analysis

\* Risk Assessment

\* Track CAPA closure and verify effectiveness.

5. Customer Complaints & Quality Requirements

\* Coordinate investigation of customer quality complaints.

\* Prepare detailed root-cause analysis and CAPA reports for customers.

\* Monitor recurring complaints and implement preventive measures.

\* Understand and maintain customer-specific quality requirements.

\* Participate in customer audits and technical discussions where required.

\* Maintain complaint trends and periodically present them to management.

6. GMP, Hygiene & Housekeeping

Ensure implementation of GMP and hygiene standards throughout the manufacturing facility, including:

\* Personnel hygiene

\* Factory housekeeping

\* Pest-control systems

\* Cleaning schedules

\* Waste management

\* Glass and brittle-plastic controls

\* Chemical controls

\* Foreign-body prevention

\* Material segregation

\* Storage practices

\* Employee movement and access controls

Ensure hygiene and food-safety requirements are implemented wherever applicable.

7. Risk Management

\* Conduct process and product risk assessments.

\* Identify quality, safety and contamination risks within manufacturing operations.

\* Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans.

\* Ensure preventive controls are established for critical processes.

\* Periodically reassess risks based on process changes, customer complaints and audit findings.

8. Traceability & Product Recall Systems

\* Establish and maintain end-to-end traceability of:

\* Raw materials

\* Printing inks and coatings

\* Consumables

\* Work-in-process materials

\* Finished goods

\* Conduct periodic mock traceability / recall exercises.

\* Ensure traceability can be demonstrated within required timelines during audits.

\* Maintain batch identification and production records.

10. Documentation & Record Control

Maintain and control QMS documentation including:

\* Quality Manual

\* SOPs

\* Work Instructions

\* Policies

\* Process Flow Charts

\* Quality Formats

\* Audit Records

\* Inspection Records

\* Training Records

\* Calibration Records

\* Maintenance Records

\* Pest-Control Records

\* Cleaning Records

\* CAPA Records

\* Complaint Records

\* Supplier Assessments

\* Risk Assessments

Ensure obsolete documents are withdrawn and only current approved versions are available for use.

11. Training & Quality Culture

\* Identify quality-system training requirements across departments.

\* Conduct induction and periodic QMS/GMP training.

\* Train employees on relevant SOPs and work instructions.

\* Conduct awareness programs related to:

\* GMP

\* Hygiene

\* Food safety

\* Quality standards

\* BRCGS requirements

\* Customer requirements

\* Maintain training records and evaluate training effectiveness.

12. Management Review

\* Prepare data for periodic Management Review Meetings.

\* Present key quality metrics including:

\* Customer complaints

\* Internal rejection

\* CAPA status

\* Audit findings

\* Supplier quality

\* Customer quality performance

\* Training compliance

\* Quality objectives

\* Certification status

\* Follow up on actions agreed during management reviews.

Key Performance Indicators – KPIs

Performance of the QMS Head will be measured through:

\* Successful completion of BRCGS / ISO and customer audits.

\* Number and severity of audit non-conformities.

\* Timely closure of CAPAs.

\* Reduction in repeat customer complaints.

\* Internal audit compliance.

\* Documentation compliance.

\* GMP and hygiene audit scores.

\* Traceability-test performance.

\* Training completion rate.

\* Reduction in recurring quality-system failures.

\* Supplier quality performance.

\* Closure of customer complaints within agreed timelines.

Qualification

Preferred Qualification:

\* B.Tech / B.E. / B.Sc. / M.Sc. / Diploma in Printing, Packaging, Engineering, Chemistry, Food Technology, Quality Management or a related discipline.

Additional certifications in the following will be preferred:

\* BRCGS Packaging Materials

\* ISO 9001

\* Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor

\* GMP

\* HACCP / Food Safety

\* FSC Chain of Custody

Experience

Preferred: 3 years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Management Systems.

At least 3–5 years in a managerial or leadership role will be preferred.

Candidates with hands-on experience in BRCGS, ISO systems, audits, CAPA, documentation control, customer quality management and continuous improvement will be given preference.

Technical Knowledge Required

The candidate should have strong practical knowledge of:

\* BRCGS Packaging Materials

\* ISO Quality Management Systems

\* GMP

\* CAPA

\* Root Cause Analysis

\* Internal Auditing

\* Risk Assessment

\* Document Control

\* Supplier Quality

\* Customer Complaint Management

\* Traceability

\* Product Recall

\* Change Control

\* Calibration Systems

\* Hygiene Management

\* Pest Control

\* Quality KPIs

Knowledge of printing and folding-carton manufacturing processes will be an added advantage.

Key Competencies

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

\* Strong ownership of quality systems

\* High attention to detail

\* Strong documentation discipline

\* Analytical and structured problem-solving ability

\* Ability to lead audits confidently

\* Ability to coordinate across multiple departments

\* Strong communication skills

\* Ability to train and influence shop-floor teams

\* Strong follow-up and closure orientation

\* Ability to work directly with senior management and customer quality teams

**Salary - 40-45k per month

For applications send cv on codasyncs.hrbp1@gmail.com with a request to fix an appointment**

Role Expectation

The QMS Head will be expected to create a system-driven quality culture rather than an audit-driven quality culture, ensuring that compliance and quality requirements become part of everyday manufacturing operations.

The individual should be capable of independently owning the QMS function and ensuring that Eastface Packaging remains continuously prepared for BRCGS, ISO, customer and regulatory audits while supporting the company’s growth and quality objectives.

I can also make this into a shorter Naukri/LinkedIn hiring version with only responsibilities, eligibility, and key skills.

title: Deployment Textile Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a hands-on Deployment Textile Engineer to support the deployment and operation of our OneWeave™ 3D weaving technology at our manufacturing partner in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, near Naroda Road.
  
  
You’ll be the first line of textile technical support onsite, working alongside factory operators, a project manager, field service technician, and unspun’s remote textile and mechanical engineering teams. You’ll investigate what’s happening in production, run tests, analyze results, solve textile and process problems, and turn what we learn on the factory floor into continuous improvement.
  
  
You’ll also represent unspun at our partner facility, building trusted relationships and helping teams across both organizations work effectively together.
  
  
When applying, use the word shark in your cover letter.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
OneWeave™ combines textiles, robotics, sensors, software, and industrial automation to create garments and textile products directly from yarn.
  
  
As we deploy and ramp this technology in production, we need textile engineering expertise directly on the factory floor. When something involving weaving, yarn, materials, fabric quality, or process performance isn’t behaving as expected, you’ll help determine what’s happening, why it’s happening, and what we should do next.
  
  
You’ll connect what’s happening onsite in Ahmedabad with the teams developing OneWeave™ in the US, helping us improve both the technology and how we operate it.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Support the deployment, testing, ramp-up, and continuous improvement of OneWeave™ at our partner factory
* Serve as the first line of response for weaving, yarn, material, fabric quality, and textile process issues
* Develop and execute test plans, operate OneWeave™ equipment, and support daily textile testing and production runs
* Perform quality testing inspection, analyzing weaving inputs and outputs using quantitative and qualitative data to identify patterns, problems, and opportunities for improvement
* Investigate textile and process issues, determine likely causes, test potential solutions, and document results
* Assess and prioritize issues based on severity, production impact, available workarounds, and urgency
* Partner with factory operations and US-based textile, mechanical, and development teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues
* Support yarn and material sourcing, supplier communication, testing, and validation for development and production runs
* Work with material vendors and suppliers on testing requirements, standards, and performance
* Develop and improve machine operation and testing SOPs, troubleshooting guides, training manuals, and supporting documentation
* Identify recurring problems and opportunities to improve equipment, materials, processes, documentation, and training
* Provide clear, concise updates to US-based teams on factory status, testing, project progress, risks, findings, and next steps
* Capture technical information so engineers who aren't physically onsite can understand factory issues and take action

**Who You Are**
You’re a textile engineer who likes being close to the actual work. You understand fibers, yarns, woven structures, fabric quality, and manufacturing processes, but you’re also comfortable getting onto the factory floor, operating equipment, running tests, and figuring out why something isn’t working as expected.
  
  
You’re curious and methodical. You don't simply fix a symptom and move on. You gather information, test assumptions, analyze results, and try to understand the underlying cause.
  
  
You also know that deployment work is collaborative. You can build strong working relationships with factory operators and managers while partnering effectively with engineers and teams thousands of miles away.
  
  
When production pressure is high, you remain composed, communicate clearly, and keep moving the work toward resolution.
  
  
**What Makes You a Great Fit?**

* 5 or more years of hands-on experience with production weaving, textile manufacturing, fabric development, and textile quality systems
* Strong understanding of textile fibers, yarn properties, woven structures, fabric quality, and manufacturing constraints
* Experience developing and executing textile or manufacturing test plans
* Ability to collect and analyze quantitative and qualitative data and translate findings into practical improvements
* Experience troubleshooting textile, weaving, material, quality, or production-process issues
* Experience working directly in a factory or production environment
* Familiarity with quality systems, root-cause analysis, production metrics such as Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and downtime analysis, or continuous-improvement methods
* Experience working with yarn or material suppliers on sourcing, testing, validation, or quality
* Strong written and verbal communication with factory operators, engineers, suppliers, and leadership
* Ability to document technical findings clearly for teams that aren't physically onsite
* Strong ownership, judgment, reliability, and process discipline

**Education**
Degree or diploma in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, or a closely related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
**Language Requirements**

* Professional working English required
* Professional working proficiency in Gujarati or Hindi required for effective factory-floor communication (proficiency in both is strongly preferred)

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience troubleshooting automated textile manufacturing equipment
* Production deployment, ramp-up, commissioning, or New Product Introduction (NPI) experience
* Experience designing practical experiments and translating results into production improvements
* Lean Manufacturing, Lean Six Sigma, structured root-cause analysis, or continuous-improvement experience
* Experience using OEE, downtime, quality, or other production data to investigate manufacturing performance

title: QA/QC ENGINEER - ELECTRONICS
description:
**ABOUT US:**

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing.

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

We are looking for a passionate
**QA/QC Engineer – Electronics**
to drive engineering excellence and maintain uncompromising quality standards across the entire satellite lifecycle. In this role, you will collaborate closely with Design, Production, and Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) teams, owning quality assurance, reliability analysis, and compliance protocols for advanced satellite electronics and hardware.

You will own the verification of space-grade components, lead root cause analyses, and ensure our systems perform reliably in the harshest orbital environments. If you are driven by precision, technical rigor, and the thrill of space exploration, this is your opportunity to put your stamp on history.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Quality Assurance Leadership:**
  Develop and implement robust QA plans, procedures, and inspection standards aligned with ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD, and industry best practices.
* **Design Phase Integration:**
  Partner with cross-functional teams during System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), and Critical Design Review (CDR) to bake quality into every phase of design.
* **Reliability & Circuit Analysis:**
  Perform network analysis, derating analysis, worst-case analysis, FMEA, FMECA, Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), and Reliability Block Diagram (RBD) studies to identify and mitigate design vulnerabilities.
* **AIT & Environmental Compliance:**
  Review and validate environmental qualification test results—including Thermal, Vibration, EMI/EMC, and Thermal Vacuum (TVAC) testing—and verify compliance with Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP).
* **Audit & Configuration Control:**
  Conduct internal and supplier quality audits while maintaining end-to-end component traceability, configuration management, and documentation control.
* **Non-Conformance Management:**
  Investigate non-conformances, perform root cause analysis (RCA), implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and drive continuous quality improvement across electronic manufacturing.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR?**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), or equivalent.
* **Experience:**
  2+ years of hands-on Quality Assurance (QA/QC) experience within Aerospace, Space, Satellite, Defence, Electronics Manufacturing, or High-Reliability Systems.
* **Standards & Compliance:**
  Strong knowledge of ECSS, ISRO-PAS, MIL-STD-883, IPC-A-610, and quality management principles.
* **Technical Expertise:**
  Practical background in supporting satellite electronics, avionics, power electronics, on-board computers, RF systems, or payloads, alongside circuit derating and worst-case analysis skills.
* **Methodologies:**
  Familiarity with FMEA, FMECA, FTA, RCA, CAPA, and reliability engineering frameworks.
* **Core Competencies:**
  Exceptional analytical thinking, rigorous documentation discipline, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* Hands-on experience in Satellite Assembly, Integration & Testing (AIT) quality processes.
* Familiarity with cleanroom operations, contamination control, and ESD-safe handling practices.
* Experience with satellite subsystems such as Reaction Wheels, Battery Systems, EPS, CDH, PCU, and RF Payloads.
* Certifications or working knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt).

**WHY JOIN US?**

* **Pioneering Impact:**
  Work at the vanguard of India's private space revolution, contributing directly to hardware that reaches orbit.
* **End-to-End Exposure:**
  Gain comprehensive visibility across the entire satellite lifecycle, from initial design reviews to final environmental testing and launch readiness.
* **Innovation Culture:**
  Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of brilliant aerospace engineers in a fast-paced, high-growth, mission-driven environment.
* **Career Growth:**
  Scale your expertise alongside state-of-the-art satellite mass-production infrastructure and global projects.

* Support departments in developing and updating procedures and work instructions.

* Strong experience in document control, risk management, corrective actions, and compliance programs.
* Experience supporting project quality documentation within engineering, manufacturing, or project delivery organizations.
* Experience leading process improvement and organizational change initiatives.

* ISO 9001 knowledge and practical application.
* Internal auditing and corrective action management.
* Risk assessment and continuous improvement.
* Process mapping and document management.
* Data analysis and reporting skills.

title: OPTICAL ENGINEER – QA (OPTICAL PAYLOADS)
description:
**ABOUT US:**

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing.

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.

**JOB SUMMARY:**

We are looking for an
**Optical Engineer – QA (Optical Payloads)**
to join our mission. In this role, you will play a critical part in overseeing quality assurance across optical fabrication, assembly, alignment, and testing for space-grade refractive and reflective imaging systems. Tailored for fresh graduates and early-career engineers (
**1–3 years of experience**
), this position offers hands-on exposure to cleanroom operations, space qualification processes, and advanced optical metrology.

You will work cross-functionally with optical design and AIT (Assembly, Integration & Testing) teams to draft QA procedures aligned with NASA, ECSS, and ISRO standards. If you have a passion for precision optics and want to launch your career in aerospace quality assurance, your journey starts here.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **QA Procedure Development:**
  Draft and implement robust quality assurance protocols for optical component fabrication, coating, and subsystem assembly following NASA, ECSS, and ISRO guidelines.
* **Cross-Functional Alignment Oversight:**
  Partner closely with optical, opto-mechanical, and system engineers during payload integration, ensuring rigorous adherence to QA guidelines during alignment using interferometers, autocollimators, and theodolites.
* **Design Review Documentation:**
  Prepare comprehensive QA chapters and compliance metrics for Preliminary and Critical Design Reviews (PDR/CDR) of optical payloads.
* **Contamination & Cleanroom Control:**
  Enforce strict cleanroom protocols and contamination control procedures through routine verification during integration and testing campaigns.
* **Test & Evaluation Execution:**
  Collaborate on test and evaluation documentation, monitoring optical parameters during environmental tests (thermal, thermal vacuum, vibration, and shock) and compiling electro-optic measurement reports.
* **Calibration Support:**
  Participate in end-to-end radiometric and spectral calibration exercises to ensure final payload performance remains strictly within design tolerances.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Optical Engineering, Applied Optics, Photonics, or a Master’s degree in Physics / Applied Physics with a strong academic focus on optics.
* **Experience:**
  Fresh graduates with relevant academic projects, internships, or lab work in optics, OR early-career professionals with
  **1–3 years**
  of experience in optical QA or related environments.
* **Core Knowledge:**
  Foundational understanding of optical principles, imaging systems, and basic optical alignment techniques.
* **Soft Skills:**
  Ability to thrive in a team-based, multidisciplinary, and fast-paced engineering environment with a keen eye for detail.

**PREFERRED / NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS:**

* Hands-on experience with optical metrology tools such as interferometers, spectrometers, or theodolites.
* Practical knowledge of cleanroom working protocols and contamination control.
* Prior academic or internship exposure to optical system testing, calibration, or environmental testing.
* Familiarity with aerospace space standards (ECSS, NASA, or ISRO).

**WHY JOIN US?**

* **Pioneering Impact:**
  Work at the forefront of India’s private aerospace revolution, contributing directly to live satellite and orbital payload missions.
* **Merit-Based Growth:**
  Azista subscribes to a merit-driven career progression model, allowing you to scale your expertise and step into technical leadership based on capability, not just vacancies.
* **Cutting-Edge Exposure:**
  Gain hands-on exposure to high-precision optical systems, space qualification workflows, and advanced cleanroom operations.
* **Collaborative Culture:**
  Join an energetic, inclusive community of engineers and innovators dedicated to making space technology accessible globally.

title: Associate Quality Auditor
description:
Actylis is a global solutions provider with over 75 years of experience, specializing in streamlining the management of critical ingredients and raw materials for our business partners.
  
  
We offer both sourcing and manufacturing solutions tailored to meet diverse and evolving needs, ensuring a reliable, agile, and secure supply network. Our commitment to customization allows us to create flexible solutions, whether it’s a unique specification, custom packaging, or tailored logistics strategies.
  
  
With deep expertise in quality and regulatory compliance, sourcing and logistics management, analytical services, and R&D support, we reduce complexities and mitigate risks, empowering our partners to focus on growing their business.
  
  
In furtherance of that goal, Actylis is seeking new members of the team. This expansion, coupled with a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for challenge and growth, make Actylis the ideal place to work and thrive. We hope you’ll consider joining us!
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Associate Quality Auditor is responsible for supporting Actylis’ supplier oversight program in India by conducting onsite audits of approved and prospective suppliers, toll manufacturers, contract manufacturers, warehouses, repackers, and contract testing laboratories.
  
  
The role evaluates whether external partners are operating in accordance with applicable Actylis quality requirements, customer expectations, and relevant quality system standards, including GMP, GDP, ISO 9001, ISO 22000/FSSC 22000, HACCP, and ISO 17025, as applicable to the supplier type and product category.
  
  
This position is intended for an early-career auditor with 2–3 years of practical auditing experience. The Associate Quality Auditor will execute structured audits, collect objective evidence, write clear audit observations, and support timely CAPA follow-up under the guidance of Supplier Quality and Global Quality leadership.
  
  
**Key Duties & Responsibilities**
**Supplier Audits and Qualification**

* Conduct onsite audits of India-based suppliers, toll manufacturers, contract manufacturers, repackers, warehouses, and testing laboratories in accordance with the approved audit schedule and Actylis supplier qualification procedures.
* Assess supplier quality systems, manufacturing controls, laboratory practices, documentation, traceability, data integrity, change control, deviation management, CAPA, complaint handling, training, and batch or testing record controls.
* Support risk-based supplier qualification, requalification, and ongoing supplier monitoring by providing audit outcomes, objective evidence, and follow-up status to Supplier Quality and Global Quality teams.

**Global Internal Audit Program Support**

* Support the Global Internal Audit program by assisting with audit preparation, checklist development, document review, audit execution, and follow-up activities across Actylis sites, as assigned.
* Participate in internal audits under the direction of the Lead Auditor or Global Quality leadership, helping assess compliance with Actylis procedures, GMP, GDP, ISO standards, and applicable quality system requirements.
* Support tracking of internal audit observations, CAPA commitments, due dates, and closure evidence to help ensure timely completion and readiness for customer, certification, or regulatory inspections.

**Compliance Oversight**

* Assess supplier compliance with applicable quality and regulatory expectations, including GMP, GDP, ISO 9001, ISO 22000/FSSC 22000, HACCP, and ISO 17025, based on the nature of the supplier and the products or services provided to Actylis.
* Identify and document potential quality and compliance risks, including deficiencies related to documentation practices, data integrity, traceability, cross-contamination controls, laboratory controls, supplier quality systems, and CAPA effectiveness.
* Escalate significant audit findings, repeat observations, overdue CAPAs, or supplier compliance concerns through the appropriate Actylis quality governance channels.

**Audit Reporting and CAPA Follow-up**

* Prepare accurate, objective, and timely audit reports that clearly summarize the audit scope, objective evidence reviewed, observations identified, and overall supplier compliance risk.
* Review supplier responses to audit observations and assess whether proposed corrective and preventive actions are appropriate, timely, and aligned with the identified root cause and compliance risk.
* Track open audit findings, CAPA commitments, and due dates to support timely follow-up and closure.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Procurement, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Control, site Quality teams, and business stakeholders to communicate audit outcomes and support supplier oversight decisions.
* Represent Actylis professionally during supplier interactions by applying an objective, respectful, and evidence-based audit approach.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of supplier audit tools, checklists, templates, risk assessment practices, and audit tracking processes.

**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Food Science, Biotechnology, or a related scientific discipline.
  
  
**Experience**

* Minimum 2–3 years of hands-on experience conducting or supporting supplier audits, internal audits, laboratory audits, GMP audits, food safety audits, or quality system assessments.
* Practical working knowledge of quality system requirements applicable to suppliers, toll manufacturers, contract manufacturers, warehouses, repackers, and testing laboratories.
* Formal audit training or certification, such as Internal Auditor, ISO 9001 Auditor, ISO 22000/FSSC 22000 Auditor, ISO 17025 Auditor, Certified Quality Auditor, or equivalent preferred.
* Experience supporting supplier qualification, vendor management, external manufacturing oversight, toll manufacturing oversight, or third-party laboratory oversight preferred.

**Functional/Technical Competencies & Skillsets**

* Working knowledge of GMP, GDP, ISO 9001, ISO 22000/FSSC 22000, HACCP, ISO 17025, supplier qualification, audit lifecycle management, and CAPA principles.
* Ability to review procedures, specifications, certificates of analysis, batch records, analytical records, validation documentation, quality agreements, and supplier responses to audit observations.
* Strong understanding of audit principles, objective evidence collection, observation classification, documentation practices, data integrity, traceability, and basic risk assessment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare factual, concise, and well-structured audit reports.
* Professional, objective, and collaborative approach when interacting with external suppliers and internal stakeholders.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining Actylis quality and compliance standards.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**
None
  
  
**Travel Requirements:**
Regular travel across India is required to conduct onsite audits of suppliers, toll manufacturers, contract manufacturers, warehouses, repackers, and contract testing laboratories. Travel frequency will be driven by the approved supplier audit schedule and business priorities.
  
  
Actylis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Actylis US does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Engineer – Defectivity (Semiconductor)
description:
**About The Business**

Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.

Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.

Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission 'To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.’

Responsibilities

1. Own inline
   **defect density performance**
   (e.g., particles/defects per wafer or per cm²) and drive reductions to meet yield, quality, and customer targets.
2. Operate and optimize
   **defect inspection**
   across tools (optical brightfield/darkfield, patterned wafer inspection) including recipe tuning, nuisance reduction, and tool-to-tool matching.
3. Define and execute
   **defect monitoring strategy**
   : Lot/monitor wafer plan, inspection points (pre/post critical steps), sampling rates, and sensitivity/recipe settings.
4. Perform
   **defect disposition and classification**
   : nuisance vs real defects, systematic vs random; maintain defect library and automate classification where applicable.
5. Lead
   **defect excursion management**
   : rapid detection, lot containment (hold/quarantine), risk assessment, and communication with Production/QA/Yield.
6. Drive
   **adder control**
   by step/tool/module: quantify adders (after–before), identify top contributing tools/recipes/chambers, and lead corrective actions.
7. Execute
   **root-cause analysis (RCA)**
   using defect maps, signature analysis, cluster/hotspot detection, equipment logs, PM history, chemical/consumable lots, and wafer transport/FOUP history
8. Coordinate
   **defect review and failure analysis**
   : SEM review, EDS, FIB cross-section requests; correlate physical defects to electrical impact with Yield/Product teams.
9. Own defect density and D0 performance; quantify defect-to-yield loss using kill ratio, CP/WAT correlation, and yield loss prediction models.
10. Lead DSA and manage the defect library/classification (real vs nuisance); drive nuisance filtering and review/BKM standardization.
11. Develop and optimize inspection recipes (sensitivity/threshold/care-area), tool matching, and post-PM qualification to control adders and excursions.
12. Drive defect reduction CIP: Pareto top contributors, RCA with module/equipment/CFM/yield teams, and implement CAPA for sustained improvement
13. Support new inspection tool installs, tech transfer, and ramp by completing tool qualification and production release, defining acceptance criteria, and ensuring sustainable capacity and uptime.
14. Mentor more Engineers as required
15. Travel, as necessary
16. Presentation to internal teams and senior executives
17. Drive cross-functional yield improvement projects and DOEs
18. Apply structured problem-solving and risk tools: FMEA, 8D, and strong RCA to drive effective corrective action and prevent recurrence
19. Ensure inspection measurement capability/accuracy via basic MSA/GR&R and tool-to-tool correlation
20. Use SPC, FDC, and APC to monitor process health, detect excursions early, and enable data-driven defect/yield control

Essential Attributes

* Able to work independently, self-motivated with a strong drive to win.
* Team player with the ability to work across diverse cross-functional teams spread across the world.
* Leadership skills to influence all levels of the organization.
* You’re inclusive, adapting your style to the situation and diverse global norms of our people.
* An avid learner, you approach challenges with curiosity and resilience, seeking data to help build understanding.
* You’re collaborative, building relationships, humbly offering support and openly welcoming approaches.
* Innovative and creative, you proactively explore new ideas and adapt quickly to change.

Qualifications

1. M.Tech/M.E. in Chemical Eng, Electrical/Electronics Eng, Mechanical Eng, Materials/Materials Science, Physical Science, or equivalent.
2. Strong understanding of
   **analytical techniques**
   (SEM, FIB, TEM, Photo-Emission, SIMS, ICP-MS, Chromatography, Nano-probing, etc).
3. Deep understanding of Semiconductor wafer Fabrication
4. Proven track record in yield improvement on new and mature technologies
5. Ability to lead cross-functional teams and achieve project completion within timeline and cost targets
6. Ability to work across different cultures and geographies
7. Good team player
8. Innovation and competitive mindset

Desired Experience Level

1. 7+ years experience in the semiconductor industry
2. Proven track record of successfully developing new technologies into high volume production
3. Proven problem solving skills using design of experiments and analytical tools

title: Product & Business Operations Associate
description:
**PRODUCT & BUSINESS OPERATIONS ASSOCIATE**

**Ahmedabad, Gujarat**

**Full-time | On-site**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

SVECTOR is hiring a Product & Business Operations Associate to work across product, customer, research and business execution.

This role is designed for an early-career technical professional who wants to operate beyond a narrow software-development function and work across technology, product, customers, research and company-building.

You will work closely with the Founder-CEO and relevant functional teams on selected high-priority initiatives across SVECTOR.

This is not an administrative role.

You will be expected to understand problems, structure them, identify what needs to happen, coordinate the relevant people and carry assigned work through to a clear and verified result.

The role requires someone who can move comfortably between technical and business problems.

**WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON**

**1. PRODUCT & BUSINESS EXECUTION**

You will take ownership of assigned product and business initiatives.

Typical responsibilities may include:

• Understanding a customer, product or business problem before work begins

• Converting unclear requests into structured problem statements and requirements

• Defining expected outcomes, owners, dependencies and timelines

• Coordinating with Product, Engineering and business teams

• Identifying missing inputs and blockers

• Following work through rather than simply forwarding instructions

• Reviewing whether the delivered result actually solves the original problem

• Maintaining clear records of open issues, decisions and next actions

• Escalating decisions when authority or additional support is required

You should be comfortable taking an objective that is initially ambiguous and turning it into practical execution.

**2. PRODUCT UNDERSTANDING**

Strong product understanding is important for this role.

You may be expected to:

• Use SVECTOR products and understand important workflows

• Understand the intended user and customer problem

• Review customer feedback and product issues

• Distinguish between defects, requirements and new product requests

• Prepare product requirements and acceptance criteria

• Understand APIs, integrations, data flows and technical dependencies

• Follow technical discussions with engineers

• Participate in demos, pilots and implementation discussions

• Verify whether an agreed workflow is actually ready

You do not need to be a full-time software developer.

However, you should have enough technical understanding to work intelligently with engineers and enough business understanding to know why the technical work matters.

**3. RESEARCH & ANALYSIS**

Research will be an important part of the role.

You may investigate:

• Companies

• Customers

• Markets

• Competitors

• Technologies

• Industries

• Product opportunities

• Enterprise accounts

• Candidates

• Market-entry questions

• Commercial models

• Strategic business questions

Good research should clearly distinguish between:

• Verified facts

• Estimates

• Assumptions

• Interpretation

• Missing information

You should be comfortable reading original material, comparing conflicting evidence, checking numbers and explaining the business implication of what you find.

We do not want surface-level summaries.

We want someone who can enter an unfamiliar subject, understand it quickly and produce a useful conclusion.

**4. AI-NATIVE WORK**

This is an AI-native role.

You should already be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or equivalent systems for professional work.

You may use AI for:

• Research

• Document analysis

• Writing

• Data organization

• Summarization

• Workflow automation

• Structured analysis

• Repetitive work

• Product thinking

However, you remain responsible for every output.

You should be able to explain:

• What you asked the system to do

• Which sources were used

• What assumptions were made

• What the model got wrong

• What you corrected

• What remains uncertain

Copying an AI-generated answer without understanding or verifying it is not acceptable.

**5. CUSTOMER & COMMERCIAL WORK**

You may support selected customer and commercial initiatives.

This may include:

• Researching customers and accounts before meetings

• Understanding customer workflows and requirements

• Preparing meeting briefs and talking points

• Drafting customer communication and follow-ups

• Preparing product or commercial material

• Coordinating internal responses to customer questions

• Maintaining customer commitments and next steps

• Supporting demos, pilots and implementation discussions

• Following open issues through to a confirmed outcome

Sending a follow-up is not the outcome.

The expectation is to understand what needs to happen next and keep the work moving until there is a clear result or next state.

**6. HIRING & PEOPLE RESEARCH**

The role may also support selected hiring initiatives.

You may work on:

• Understanding why a role exists

• Preparing role briefs

• Researching candidates

• Reviewing candidate evidence

• Preparing interview material

• Comparing candidates

• Coordinating selected hiring processes

• Maintaining accurate hiring records and next steps

This is not an HR or Talent Acquisition position.

The objective is to support better hiring decisions using structured evidence.

**7. BUSINESS COMMUNICATION & MEETING PREPARATION**

You may prepare:

• Customer briefs

• Internal memos

• Research summaries

• Meeting notes

• Talking points

• Product requirements

• Candidate comparisons

• Proposal content

• Presentation outlines

• Follow-up communication

For important meetings, you may be expected to understand:

• Who is attending

• Prior correspondence

• Relevant documents

• Outstanding questions

• Previous commitments

• Intended meeting outcome

• Required next actions

When the same topic returns later, the relevant context should already be organized and available.

**8. OWNERSHIP STANDARD**

This role is built around ownership.

We do not consider the following to be completed work:

“I sent the message.”

“I followed up.”

“I informed the team.”

“I completed my part.”

The expected operating pattern is:

Understand the result.

Build the plan.

Get the required inputs.

Move the work.

Resolve blockers.

Escalate what genuinely requires a decision.

Check the final result.

Close the loop.

For important assignments, you should always know:

• What outcome is expected

• Who is responsible

• What information is missing

• What dependencies exist

• What deadline applies

• What could block completion

• What remains unresolved

• What decision is required

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are particularly interested in early-career candidates with a strong technical foundation.

Preferred educational backgrounds include:

• Computer Science

• Computer Engineering

• Information Technology

• Software Engineering

• Artificial Intelligence

• Related technical disciplines

Typically, we are looking for candidates with approximately 1 to 5 years of professional experience.

Exceptional recent graduates with strong evidence of ownership, technical ability, product thinking or real-world execution are also encouraged to apply.

Relevant backgrounds may include:

• Product

• Product Operations

• Business Analysis

• Technical Consulting

• Technical Pre-Sales

• Implementation

• Solutions

• Customer Success for technical products

• AI products

• Enterprise software

• Technical project execution

• Early-stage startup roles

**WHAT WE VALUE**

**HIGH OWNERSHIP**

You attempt solutions and move work forward without waiting for detailed instructions at every step.

**TECHNICAL FLUENCY**

You can understand software products, APIs, integrations, data flows and implementation constraints.

**PRODUCT THINKING**

You think about the user, customer problem, workflow and outcome, not only the feature.

**RESEARCH DEPTH**

You can independently investigate unfamiliar subjects and reach a reasoned conclusion.

**STRONG WRITING**

Your work should be clear, structured and usable without requiring complete rewriting.

**JUDGMENT**

You understand what you can handle independently and what genuinely requires escalation.

**RELIABILITY**

If you commit to something, it gets done, or the problem is raised before the deadline.

**LEARNING SPEED**

You can enter a new subject, ask precise questions and become useful quickly.

**AI FLUENCY**

You use modern AI tools seriously and understand how to verify their outputs.

**DISCRETION**

You will have access to company, customer, personnel and strategic information. Confidential information must remain confidential and be shared only with authorized people for legitimate company work.

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**

This is not:

• A personal assistant role

• A calendar-management position

• An administrative support role

• A pure strategy job

• A pure research role

• A pure software-development role

• A conventional project coordinator position

• A role where work ends after forwarding an instruction

Personal errands, household matters and lifestyle management are outside the scope of this position.

**WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Employment: Full-time

Work mode: On-site

The environment is fast-moving and priorities may change as customer, product and company requirements evolve.

You should be comfortable operating in ambiguity while creating structure around the work you own.

Important product, customer or company matters may occasionally require responsiveness outside normal working hours.

**SELECTION PROCESS**

We care more about actual ability than polished interview answers.

The selection process may include:

1. Initial conversation

2. Product or research exercise

3. Business writing / execution exercise

4. Final discussion

AI tools may be used during selected exercises.

Candidates will be expected to explain their reasoning, sources, assumptions, decisions and corrections.

If you are young, technically strong, curious about business, comfortable with AI, capable of learning quickly and want to work across product, customers and execution rather than remain inside one narrow function, we would like to hear from you.

In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 7 consecutive years of net sales growth. This consistent, category-leading growth is a testament to the strength of our team, strategy, and portfolio of brands.
  
  
Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a hybrid 3 day in office, 2 day at home work environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry.
  
  
Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us
  
  
**Position Summary:**
The Precisely/Evolve MDM Analyst will serve as e.l.f. Beauty’s primary technical owner of the Precisely/Evolve platform, driving data quality, enrichment, and master data management across customer, vendor, and product domains. This is a platform-forward role for someone who is hands-on with Precisely/Evolve workflows and brings the analytical mindset to continuously improve data health at scale. Experience with SAP master data is strongly encouraged — the two platforms are closely linked in our environment — and candidates who bring dual platform fluency will have a meaningful advantage. The ideal hire is proactive, technically sharp, and eager to build and improve, not just maintain.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Precisely/Evolve Platform - Primary Focus**

* Own the administration, configuration, and ongoing optimization of Precisely/Evolve for data quality, enrichment, matching, and survivorship across customer, vendor, and product master domains
* Design, build, test, and deploy data quality rules, enrichment workflows, and matching/survivorship logic within the Precisely/Evolve platform
* Monitor pipeline performance, proactively identify processing gaps or failures, and implement improvements to accuracy and throughput
* Evaluate and adopt new Precisely/Evolve features and product updates relevant to e.l.f.’s data environment
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for all Precisely/Evolve workflows, configurations, and data quality rules
* Serve as the internal subject matter expert on the Precisely/Evolve platform, supporting onboarding, training, and troubleshooting for business and IT users

**MDM Domain Knowledge — Required Foundation**

* Apply master data management principles across customer, vendor, and product domains to define what “good data” looks like — including data standards, field-level rules, hierarchy structures, and source-of-truth logic
* Design matching and survivorship rules grounded in business context: understanding which record wins, why, and what the downstream impact is if that logic is wrong
* Develop and enforce data quality thresholds by domain, with clear understanding of business consequences for each type of quality failure
* Partner with data owners to define and document master data standards that translate directly into platform configuration

**Cross-Domain Data Stewardship**
  
  

+ Apply technical and domain expertise across all three master data domains — customer, vendor, and product — ensuring consistency, completeness, and accuracy across platforms and downstream systems
+ Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT to understand domain-specific requirements and translate them into technical rules, validation logic, and platform configuration
+ Collaborate with IT on integration design to ensure Precisely/Evolve outputs flow correctly into connected systems including SAP

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience with Precisely (formerly Syncsort/Trillium) or Evolve, including workflow configuration, data quality rule development, and platform administration — required
* Demonstrated MDM domain knowledge across one or more of the following: customer master, vendor master, product/material master — required. Breadth across all three is a strong plus
* Ability to design matching, survivorship, and enrichment logic from first principles — not just execute pre-built configurations — required
* Experience with SAP master data management (Material Master, Customer Master, and/or Vendor Master) strongly preferred; dual Precisely/Evolve + SAP experience is a significant differentiator
* Proven ability to identify data quality gaps and proactively drive platform or process improvements
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to data detail and integrity
* Ability to work cross-functionally with business and IT teams, translating technical concepts clearly for non-technical audiences
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to collaborate effectively across time zones with global teams
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP MDG (Master Data Governance), or data integration middleware a plus
* Beauty, retail, or consumer packaged goods industry background preferred but not required

**Technical Skills**

* Precisely/Evolve — workflow configuration, data quality rules, enrichment, matching, and survivorship (required)
* MDM domain knowledge — customer, vendor, and/or product/material master (required)
* SAP ERP / S/4HANA — Material Master, Customer Master, and/or Vendor Master (strongly preferred)
* SQL or equivalent querying tools for data analysis and investigation
* Data integration concepts and API-based or batch data flows
* Microsoft Excel (advanced) for data analysis, reconciliation, and reporting

title: Electronics Engineer- Firmware
description:
Job Description: Electronics Firmware Engineer

Company: On2Cook

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Experience: 2–4 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Kitchen Technology | Consumer Electronics | Product Development

About On2Cook

On2Cook is an award-winning kitchen technology company revolutionizing the way the world cooks. Our patented technology combines microwave and induction cooking to deliver faster, more energy-efficient, and consistent cooking performance.

We are developing innovative cooking appliances and connected kitchen solutions that bring together hardware, embedded systems, and intelligent technology to transform professional and modern kitchens.

Join us to be part of a team building next-generation cooking technology and smart appliances.

Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled Electronics Firmware Engineer to develop, test, and optimize embedded firmware for On2Cook's innovative cooking appliances and electronic products.

In this role, you will work closely with hardware engineers, software developers, and product design teams to develop reliable firmware, integrate electronic components, and enable seamless communication between hardware and software systems.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with microcontrollers, embedded C/C++ programming, hardware-software integration, and wireless communication protocols, along with a passion for building innovative consumer electronics and connected appliances.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, test, and maintain embedded firmware for cooking appliances, electronic systems, and connected product solutions.
* Implement firmware for microcontrollers such as ESP32, STM32, and Nordic nRF series.
* Collaborate with hardware, software, mechanical engineering, and product design teams to ensure seamless hardware-software integration.
* Develop and optimize firmware for device control, sensor integration, communication interfaces, and real-time system performance.
* Work with communication protocols such as Bluetooth, BLE, Wi-Fi, MQTT, and TCP/IP for connected product functionality.
* Implement and maintain peripheral interfaces, including SPI, I2C, UART, and Modbus, as required by product specifications.
* Participate in firmware architecture design, technical feasibility studies, prototyping, and new product development (NPD).
* Perform firmware debugging, testing, validation, and performance optimization to ensure product reliability and stability.
* Identify and resolve firmware-related issues during prototyping, integration, and product testing.
* Follow coding standards, version control practices, documentation procedures, and firmware development best practices.
* Evaluate new technologies, tools, and embedded solutions to improve product performance and functionality.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to meet project milestones, product specifications, and quality requirements.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in embedded firmware development for electronic products, consumer appliances, or mechatronic systems.
* Strong programming skills in Embedded C/C++.
* Practical experience with microcontrollers such as ESP32, STM32, and Nordic nRF series.
* Knowledge of real-time operating systems (RTOS) and embedded system architecture.
* Experience with wireless communication technologies and protocols, including Bluetooth, BLE, Wi-Fi, MQTT, and TCP/IP.
* Understanding of peripheral communication interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, and Modbus.
* Familiarity with firmware debugging tools, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and hardware testing methodologies.
* Experience with version control systems such as Git and embedded development environments.
* Understanding of hardware-software integration, electronic circuits, sensors, and microcontroller-based control systems.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced product development environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience developing firmware for consumer electronics, smart appliances, IoT devices, or connected products.
* Exposure to new product development, prototyping, and product validation processes.
* Familiarity with device communication, remote monitoring, and connected product ecosystems.
* Experience working with sensors, actuators, control systems, and electronic power management.
* Understanding of product reliability, safety, and performance testing.

Why Join On2Cook?

* Innovative technology: Contribute to the development of patented cooking technology and next-generation kitchen appliances.
* End-to-end product development: Work on real-world products from concept and prototyping through testing and refinement.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Work with experienced professionals across electronics, firmware, software, mechanical engineering, and product design.
* Technical growth: Explore embedded systems, connected appliances, IoT technologies, and intelligent product solutions.
* Meaningful impact: Help develop technology that improves cooking speed, efficiency, and the overall kitchen experience.
* Career development: Grow your expertise in embedded systems and consumer product innovation.
* About Our Innovation Ecosystem
* On2Cook is part of an innovation ecosystem focused on developing practical, technology-driven products. Our work combines engineering, design, and innovation to bring differentiated products to market.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at hr@on2cook.com with the subject line “Application – Electronics Firmware Engineer.”

Join On2Cook and help engineer the future of smart cooking technology!

You know how healthcare software works. You can understand a customer’s workflows, design the right configuration, explain the product confidently and take an implementation through to go-live.

Script Assist is hiring a
**Senior Implementation Consultant**
with experience implementing, configuring and optimising Electronic Health Record (EHR), Electronic Medical Record (EMR), Electronic Patient Record (EPR) or Hospital Information System (HIS / HMIS) platforms.

We are particularly interested in professionals with experience across Oracle Health / Cerner, eClinicalWorks, Altera / Allscripts, Epic, NextGen Healthcare, InterSystems TrakCare, MEDITECH, athenahealth, Dedalus or comparable healthcare software.

You may currently work at an EHR vendor, a healthcare technology company, or within the healthcare technology consulting teams of PwC, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, Accenture, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, HCLTech or CitiusTech.
