**🏥 About Script Assist**

Script Assist is building the technology and operating infrastructure behind next-generation private healthcare in the UK.

Our platform already supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month, with established scale in medical cannabis and expansion into ADHD, weight management, longevity and specialist private medicine.

We bring together the workflows that clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators need to run their services:

• Patient onboarding and patient portals

• Clinical consultations and scheduling

• Prescribing and repeat prescriptions

• Pharmacy, dispensing and inventory

• Payments and operational workflows

• Patient communications, reporting and integrations

Every customer operates differently. Your role is to understand those differences, design the right solution and help each customer get the best from Script Assist.

You will work directly with UK healthcare customers and closely with our leadership, Product and Engineering teams—with real influence over customer delivery and product development.

**🎯 The opportunity**

You will become a product expert and trusted client lead for UK clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators.

You will understand their operations, design their workflows, configure their solution, demonstrate the product, train their teams and guide them through implementation.

After go-live, you will retain ownership of the relationship, helping customers resolve problems, improve adoption and develop how they use the platform.

The role brings together:

• EHR implementation and functional consulting

• Clinical and operational workflow design

• Application configuration and solution design

• Client workshops, product demonstrations and training

• UAT, go-live and post-implementation optimisation

• Ongoing client ownership and stakeholder management

Workflow discovery and functional solution design

• Lead client discovery sessions and requirements workshops.

• Map clinical and operational processes into clear system workflows.

• Translate requirements into configuration decisions, functional specifications and acceptance criteria.

• Advise customers on how to use the product effectively.

• Identify dependencies, explain trade-offs and challenge requirements constructively.

EHR application configuration

• Configure or lead the configuration of modules, forms, clinical templates, user roles, permissions, rules and system settings.

• Understand how configuration decisions affect the wider patient, clinician and pharmacy journey.

• Work across registration, appointments, clinical documentation, prescribing, medication management, work queues, patient portals and payments.

• Identify which requirements can be met through configuration and which need integration or product development.

Implementation and go-live

• Own customer delivery from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, training and go-live.

• Coordinate data migration, integrations and customer dependencies with specialist teams.

• Lead UAT preparation, issue resolution and go-live readiness.

• Deliver product demonstrations, workflow walkthroughs and user training.

• Manage hypercare and the transition into ongoing platform use.

Client consulting and relationship ownership

• Lead meetings with clinicians, operational managers and senior healthcare stakeholders.

• Explain system behaviour and recommendations clearly and confidently.

• Manage expectations, priorities, actions and escalations.

• Maintain a detailed understanding of each customer’s workflows, configuration and objectives.

• Build lasting relationships through product knowledge, sound judgement and reliable follow-through.

Post-implementation optimisation

• Remain directly involved after go-live.

• Improve adoption, workflows, configuration and user confidence.

• Diagnose issues involving permissions, data, configuration, training, integrations or software behaviour.

• Translate product gaps into clear requirements for Product and Engineering.

• Validate fixes and follow issues through to resolution.

**✅ The experience we are looking for**

• Typically 3–8 years of relevant EHR, EMR, EPR, HIS or clinical information systems experience. Strong candidates outside this range are welcome.

• Deep functional knowledge of at least one substantial healthcare software platform.

• Personal involvement in system configuration or detailed configuration design.

• Experience delivering implementations or substantial optimisation projects for external healthcare customers.

• Direct responsibility for client workshops, requirements discussions, training or implementation decisions.

• Confidence investigating application and workflow problems.

• Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, QA and Support.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to independently lead senior UK client conversations.

• A hands-on approach and enthusiasm for learning a complex healthcare product.

**🔎 Relevant platforms and backgrounds**

We welcome experience with:

• Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium

• eClinicalWorks / eCW

• Altera Digital Health / Allscripts, including Sunrise and TouchWorks

• Veradigm

• Epic

• NextGen Healthcare / NextGen Enterprise

• InterSystems TrakCare

• MEDITECH / Expanse

• athenahealth / athenaOne

• Dedalus

• PracticeSuite, MicroMD, Napier, Ohum and other substantial EHR / EMR / HIS platforms

Relevant functional experience may include ambulatory care, outpatient workflows, patient administration, scheduling, clinical documentation, electronic prescribing, medication management, pharmacy, patient engagement and practice management.

Experience working with US, UK or other international healthcare customers is particularly valuable.

Relevant current or previous roles

Your title may be:

• Functional Consultant / Senior Functional Consultant

• Clinical Consultant / Clinical Applications Consultant

• Application Consultant / Application Specialist

• Delivery Consultant / Senior Associate Delivery Consultant

• EMR Consultant / EHR Consultant

• Clinical Information System Consultant

• Post Implementation Project Manager

• Implementation Manager / Client Onboarding Manager

title: Customer Relationship Management Consultant
description:
Customer Care Transformation Consultant

**Engagement:**
 Monthly contract. Full-time on the client through diagnostics, then a delivery role as the program moves into training and monitoring.

About the role
  

OriginBluy is running a Customer Care Gold Standard program for a large utility that serves more than 23 lakh households through 60+ walk-in service centres and an inbound call centre.

The consultant is our person on the ground: they diagnose how service works today, help define the Gold Standard, and stay through training and monitoring until the client’s own managers can hold the standard.

They report to the Principal Coach and work directly with the client’s customer care leadership, centre managers and call centre teams.

What you’ll do

**Diagnose**

* Run mystery shopping at walk-in centres: brief and calibrate the shoppers, score visits and consolidate the findings
* Select and listen to recorded calls with a focus on outliers (best, worst, repeat and escalated calls) and find the root cause of each: behaviour, process, system or policy
* Interview centre managers, call centre team leads and functional heads
* Pull together existing SOPs, scripts, QA formats and MIS into one baseline

**Define**

* Map the end-to-end customer journey for the top contact reasons, both walk-in and call
* Draft the Gold Standard: interaction standards, scripts, SOPs, escalation paths and the scorecard
* Build the cost-benefit case with client Finance: contact volumes, repeat rates, cost per contact
* Run dry runs of the new standard with a pilot group and refine it

**Deliver and sustain**

* Co-deliver CSE and manager workshops with the trainer
* Administer the Ready-for-floor certification test
* Run post-training mystery shopping and call audits, produce centre-wise scores and prepare packs for leadership reviews
* Coach centre managers and TLs to observe, score and coach against the standard

What you bring

**Must have**

* **10–15 years in customer service operations**
  , including all three of the following:
* **Inbound call centre:**
   managed or ran operations or quality for an inbound voice operation, ideally 50+ seats. Hands-on with call quality monitoring, AHT, first-contact resolution, CSAT and repeat-call analysis.
* **Walk-in service centres:**
   managed a network of customer service centres or branches. Knows queue and token management, counter processes, document-heavy service requests and how to manage a multi-location network.
* **Transformation projects:**
   led at least two service transformation or process improvement projects end to end. This could be SOP standardisation, a service redesign, a contact-centre turnaround, or harmonising processes after a merger, with results you can show.
* Comfortable with data: builds analyses in Excel, works with call logs and MIS, and can turn numbers into a business case
* Can run a good interview and a good workshop. Credible with a functional head and comfortable with a frontline executive.
* **Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English**
   (spoken; written Gujarati preferred)
* Willing to travel extensively within Gujarat

**Good to have**

* Experience in utilities, city gas distribution, power distribution, telecom, banking or insurance, meaning large regulated consumer bases with high volumes of service requests
* Familiarity with regulator-defined service standards and complaint timelines (e.g., PNGRB, state electricity regulatory commission norms)
* Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt or above) or COPC exposure
* Experience with outsourced or agency staffing models in contact centres
* Training delivery or facilitation experience

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* A credible baseline from mystery shopping and call audits that the client’s leadership accepts
* A Gold Standard draft built from the client’s own best interactions, signed off by the client owner
* A cost-benefit case that the client’s Finance team has validated
* Strong working relationships with centre managers and call centre TLs, so that they see the program as support rather than an audit

Personal attributes

* Good at reading and getting on with people on the shop floor; earns trust quickly with frontline teams
* Rigorous with evidence: separates what they saw from what they were told
* Discreet with client data and with individual performance information
* Self-directed and able to run the program on the ground without close supervision

title: Supplier Development Professional – Specialist
description:
**About Milacron**
We serve the primary market segment: Milacron Injection, Molding & Extrusion (MIME), which designs, manufactures, and sells injection and extrusion equipment, co-injection systems and related parts and services.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
The Milacron Supplier Development group, a global and progressive function within Milacron, is currently seeking strong, results-oriented candidates for the positions as a Supplier Quality Professional ranging from Specialist to Engineer.
  
  
Reporting to Global Supplier Development, this position will support, facilitate, and lead Supplier Development actions for multiple regional facilities. The role focuses on supply chain performance with responsibility for supplier quality, assessing supplier capability, verifying the quality of purchased items at the source, providing timely and accurate supplier performance metrics, facilitating continuous improvement and training of the supporting supply base. In this role you will manage the resolution of supplier quality issues at the regional facilities as well as global suppliers for specific categories.
  
  
As part of the Supplier Development organization, you will provide technical guidance in the use of quality management tools incorporating the technical disciplines found in FAI, PPAP, SPC, FMEA, Control Plans and Problem Analysis. Coordinate formal supplier training to drive consistency in process, including supplier continuous improvement and development programs. Work with underperforming suppliers to improve On-time Delivery (OTD) and non-conformance rates using improvement tools like 8Ds, A3’s, etc. Review and maintain evaluations of perspective suppliers and existing supplier performance, report status of supplier performance, and proactively act when quality trends indicate such action is warranted. Serve as liaison between engineering, procurement, quality and production to assure quality and reliability from the supply base. In addition, you will help build and sustain a strategic supply base that aligns with the corporate category management team strategy.
  
  
**General Characteristics**
***To perform this job successfully, the candidate will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform the essential duties proficiently.***

* Process and results driven with strong project management skills
* Have functional working knowledge of Quality Engineering principles
* Be a self-starter with a proven ability to manage supplier improvement initiatives
* Strategically lead supplier performance improvement projects to increase the supplier capability of consistently meeting Milacron requirements
* Must be able to establish cross functional relationships and partnerships through your product and process knowledge
* Implement and monitor the part qualification and certification process with elected suppliers
* Champion problem solving and root cause analysis activities with suppliers and customers to eliminate recurrence of non-conformances
* Function as liaison between procurement, engineering, manufacturing and suppliers to resolve supplier quality issues and to provide technical support
* Work to resolve supplier technical issues in a timely manner to ensure continuity of supply
* Support leadership and maintain a high level of performance in carrying out the goals of the department and corporation
* Review targeted supplier manufacturing processes, evaluate supplier root cause corrective actions relative to those processes and confirm identified failure modes.
* Ability to travel (up to 50%) is required

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Supplier Development, Manufacturing Quality or Supplier Quality Engineering in a manufacturing environment or Comparable Work Experience
* Understanding of Print Reading and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerance (GD&T)
* Experience in Casting, Machining and Machined Components is preferred
* Experience in facilitating change and working with cross functional teams including engineering and manufacturing
* Experience in a high mix low volume global business is desired
* Familiarity in auditing supplier manufacturing processes and quality systems
* Familiarity with US and International Industry measurement standards and tools
* Familiarity with quality standards such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and compliance auditing experience
* Experience in using structured problem solving to drive acute and chronic quality issues to closure

**Education**

* B.E/B. Tech degree from an accredited 4-year college or university in a technical or supply chain related discipline or equivalent combination of education and experience with a minimum of 4 years of experience in Quality, Manufacturing, Shop Operations, Materials or Sourcing
* Proficient oral and written communication skills
* Proficient in English language (verbal and written communications).

**Who We Are**
Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company’s 1,900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27,000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron’s global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America.
  
  
**Eeo**
The policy of Milacron is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. We are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offer opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@milacron.com. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

title: Quality Inspector
description:
**Company Description**
Govind Glass and Industries Ltd is a manufacturing company specializing in glass products for a range of industrial and commercial applications. The organization focuses on consistent product quality, operational efficiency, and meeting customer specifications. Production facilities are equipped with modern machinery to support high-volume output while maintaining quality standards. Team members are encouraged to contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and safe working practices.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Quality Inspector role based in Ahmedabad. The Quality Inspector is responsible for inspecting glass products at various stages of production to ensure they meet internal standards and customer requirements. Day-to-day tasks include performing visual and dimensional inspections, documenting inspection results, identifying nonconformities, and coordinating with production teams to resolve quality issues. The role also involves monitoring processes, supporting root cause analysis, and assisting in the implementation of corrective and preventive actions to improve overall product quality.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong foundation in Quality Control and Inspection, with the ability to apply standards and procedures consistently.
* Experience or understanding of Quality Assurance and Quality Management practices to support continuous improvement.
* Well-developed Analytical Skills for interpreting data, identifying trends, and supporting root cause analysis.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in measurement, documentation, and reporting of quality findings.
* Ability to read and understand technical drawings, specifications, and work instructions.
* Effective communication skills for collaborating with production, maintenance, and management teams.
* Previous experience in manufacturing or glass industry quality roles is an advantage.
* Relevant technical diploma, degree, or vocational qualification in engineering, materials, or a related field preferred.

title: SENIOR ELECTRONICS ENGINEER (FIRMWARE)
description:
**ABOUT US**

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing.

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.

**JOB SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to own the design, development, and verification of high-reliability firmware for our microcontroller-based satellite subsystems. In this role, you will work at the intersection of bare-metal software development and cutting-edge hardware, converting complex aerospace requirements into robust, high-performance C code.

As a key member of our engineering division, you will directly drive firmware architecture, schematic integration, and bench-level debugging. Your ownership will directly impact sub-system reliability, hardware-software integration speed, and the overall execution of our active low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite platforms.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Firmware Architecture & Design:**
  Architect, write, and debug bare-metal and low-level embedded C firmware for ARM 32-bit microcontroller systems powering satellite payloads and sub-systems.
* **Hardware-Software Integration:**
  Review hardware schematics, block diagrams, and datasheets to bring up board support packages (BSPs) and implement device drivers for analog and digital peripherals.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner closely with hardware design, thermal, and systems engineering teams to translate high-level mission requirements into optimal firmware features.
* **Hardware Bench Debugging:**
  Perform root-cause analysis, hardware bring-up, and physical debugging using DSOs (Digital Storage Oscilloscopes), logic analyzers, and multimeters.
* **Protocol & Bus Implementation:**
  Configure and optimize robust embedded communication interfaces including UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, RS232/RS485, and USB.
* **Quality & Lifecycle Management:**
  Maintain version control, maintain code standards (e.g., MISRA C guidelines), and write technical documentation, design notes, and test cases to ensure space-grade software reliability.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **Experience:**
  4–8 years of hands-on experience in embedded C firmware development for microcontroller-based systems.
* **Education:**
  BE / B.Tech / ME / M.Tech / M.Sc. in Electronics Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
* **Core Programming:**
  Expert proficiency in Embedded C and bare-metal programming without reliance on abstraction layers.
* **Hardware Understanding:**
  Solid grasp of digital and analog electronics concepts, including DAC/ADC interfaces and schematic reading.
* **Lab Equipment:**
  Hands-on experience troubleshooting, testing, and debugging hardware using DSOs, multimeters, and logic analyzers.

**PREFERRED / DESIRABLE SKILLS**

* **Microcontroller Expertise:**
  Direct experience with ARM 32-bit microcontrollers, specifically Microchip SAM V71 architectures and the MPLAB IDE ecosystem.
* **Code Quality & Standards:**
  Working knowledge of MISRA C compliance and defensive programming techniques for high-reliability systems.
* **Protocols:**
  Practical exposure to industrial and aerospace protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, RS232/RS485, USB).

**WHY JOIN US?**

* **Pioneer Space Tech:**
  Work directly on active satellite platforms inside India's first mass-production space facility.
* **Vertically Integrated Impact:**
  See your code move rapidly from design and bench testing to integrated satellite hardware orbiting Earth.
* **Engineering Excellence:**
  Collaborate with world-class engineers across hardware, thermal, payload, and mission control domains.
* **Career Acceleration:**
  Scale your skills in a high-growth sector with continuous exposure to complex, space-grade embedded systems.
* **Competitive Package:**
  Attractive salary, comprehensive health benefits, and a culture that celebrates technical innovation and autonomy.

title: Associate AI & Business Operations
description:
**About CallHippo**
CallHippo is an AI-driven business communication platform serving 5,000+ companies worldwide. Our solutions include business calling, AI voice agents, call-centre software, conversation intelligence, and an omnichannel inbox, with virtual numbers in 150+ countries and 100+ integrations.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a problem-solver who can understand how our business operates across departments, identify process gaps, and drive improvements that make the company more efficient. You will work across teams to understand existing workflows, identify bottlenecks, unnecessary manual effort, duplication, and opportunities for improvement. You will then recommend and implement practical solutions using process redesign, automation, existing software, AI tools, or other suitable approaches.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Understand business processes: Map and analyse workflows across departments to understand how work gets done and where gaps exist.
* Identify improvement opportunities: Find bottlenecks, inefficiencies, repetitive tasks, delays, and unnecessary costs.
* Recommend solutions: Propose practical improvements through workflow redesign, process standardisation, automation, AI, or better use of existing tools.
* Drive implementation: Work with cross-functional teams to turn recommendations into working solutions and ensure adoption.
* Explore AI and automation: Evaluate relevant tools, build proofs of concept, and implement solutions where they create measurable value.
* Measure business impact: Track improvements in productivity, turnaround time, operational costs, accuracy, and overall efficiency.
* Collaborate across teams: Work with business, product, engineering, and operations teams to solve problems and improve execution.
* Take ownership: Follow initiatives from identifying the problem to implementing the solution and measuring the outcome.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 2-3 years of professional experience with a strong problem-solving mindset.
* Strong understanding of business workflows and cross-functional processes.
* Ability to identify operational gaps, analyse root causes, and recommend practical improvements.
* Structured problem-solving skills and the ability to break complex business problems into actionable steps.
* Comfort with data, process mapping, workflow documentation, and performance metrics.
* Familiarity with AI tools and automation platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Grokbot
* Ability to work independently, collaborate with different teams, and drive initiatives through execution.
* Strong communication skills to explain problems, recommendations, and business impact clearly.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.
  
  
For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.
  
  
Quality Engineer - IBMS, Ahmedabad (1-Year Contract Role)
  
  
Johnson Controls delivers innovative building technologies that support smarter, healthier, and more sustainable environments. In this role, you will help ensure quality across IBMS project execution with a strong focus on
**IBMS, CCTV, and ACS**
, while working on-site in Ahmedabad. This is a one-year contractual opportunity, renewable annually based on performance.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As a Quality Engineer, you will support the quality assurance and quality control of IBMS installations by reviewing workmanship, verifying compliance with drawings and specifications, and coordinating with project stakeholders to close observations efficiently. You will play a key role in maintaining quality standards across site activities, inspections, and system checks.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Conduct site inspections and quality checks for IBMS installations, with emphasis on CCTV and ACS systems.
* Verify that execution at site aligns with approved drawings, technical specifications, and project quality standards.
* Monitor installation workmanship and identify deviations, defects, or rework requirements.
* Coordinate with clients, contractors, vendors, and internal teams to resolve quality-related issues.
* Support testing, inspection, and documentation activities during implementation and handover.
* Maintain accurate quality records, site reports, and follow-up actions.
* Track technical and operational issues through closure and support corrective actions.
* Ensure safety and compliance requirements are followed during site activities.

How You Will Do It
  
  

* Stay close to the site and verify work against drawings, specifications, and agreed quality standards.
* Own issues through to closure by documenting findings, coordinating corrective actions, and confirming that rework meets expectations.
* Work openly with clients, contractors, vendors, and internal teams to remove obstacles and keep delivery moving.
* Use disciplined reporting and clear communication to surface risks early and improve quality every day.
* Apply a practical, detail-focused approach to inspections, system checks, and handover support.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Engineering, preferably in Electrical, Electronics, IT, or a related field.
* 5 years of experience in IBMS project execution, quality checks, or site supervision.
* Hands-on experience with IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, layouts, and specifications.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and coordination skills.
* Understanding of safety, compliance, and site quality practices.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Exposure to large-scale infrastructure or facility management projects.
* Experience with additional IBMS or ELV systems such as CFS.

Why Join Us
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to contribute to quality-focused IBMS delivery in a global company committed to smart and sustainable building solutions. You will work with a collaborative team, strengthen your technical expertise, and gain hands-on exposure to site quality execution in a performance-based contractual role.
  
  
If you are ready to bring your IBMS quality experience to a role where your work will be seen and valued, we encourage you to apply.

title: QA Engineer
description:
Actowiz Solutions
  
  
QA Engineer
  
  
0-2 years
  
  
Ahmedabad
  
  
Full-Time
  
  
****About The Role****
We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer to join our R&D Department. The candidate will be responsible for validating web-scraped data, reviewing sample files, testing API responses, verifying client-specific requirements, and ensuring that all deliverables meet defined quality standards before submission.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with developers, Team Leads (TLs), and Assistant Team Leads (ATLs) to identify defects, maintain quality benchmarks, and prevent recurring data extraction issues.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Data Quality Assurance


+ Validate scraped data against the source website and client requirements.
+ Verify field-level accuracy, completeness, consistency, and data types.
+ Identify missing fields, incorrect values, duplicate records, and formatting issues.
+ Validate product details, pricing, availability, URLs, identifiers, and other relevant attributes.

* Sample and Deliverable Validation


+ Review sample files before they are marked as QA-passed or submitted to clients.
+ Ensure that the output structure, column names, file naming conventions, and data formats match the specified requirements.
+ Validate samples against the approved requirements and reference examples.
+ Maintain evidence of validation and document any defects identified.

* API Testing


+ Validate API requests and responses, including HTTP status codes, response structures, required fields, and error handling.
+ Verify JSON, CSV, Excel, and other required output formats.
+ Test pagination, filtering, and relevant request parameters wherever applicable.
+ Use Postman or similar tools for API validation.

* Defect Management and RCA


+ Report defects with clear descriptions, sample records, screenshots, and reproduction steps.
+ Coordinate with developers and TLs/ATLs for defect resolution and retesting.
+ Identify recurring quality issues and contribute to Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
+ Maintain defect logs and track issues until closure.

* Quality Process Improvement


+ Develop and maintain QA checklists for different projects and platforms.
+ Identify opportunities to automate repetitive validation tasks using Python.
+ Track quality metrics, including defect rates, first-pass acceptance, rework, and sample rejection trends.
+ Recommend improvements to reduce recurring errors and improve delivery reliability.

****Required Skills****




+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
+ Experience in manual testing, data validation, or software QA.
+ Basic to intermediate Python knowledge for data validation and automation.
+ Experience working with JSON, CSV, Excel, and structured datasets.
+ Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes, and response validation.
+ Familiarity with Postman, Excel, and basic SQL/MongoDB queries.
+ Excellent attention to detail and documentation skills.

****Preferred Qualifications****




+ Experience in web scraping, crawling, e-commerce data, or data extraction projects.
+ Knowledge of HTML, CSS selectors, XPath, and browser developer tools.
+ Experience with automated testing frameworks or data comparison scripts.
+ Familiarity with Git and issue-tracking systems.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**




+ Accuracy and completeness of QA validation.
+ Number of defects identified before client submission.
+ Reduction in recurring defects and sample rejections.
+ Compliance with project-specific QA checklists.
+ Timely completion of QA reviews.
+ Quality and completeness of defect reports and RCAs.
+ Effectiveness of retesting and defect closure.

**Expected Outcome**
The QA Engineer will establish an independent quality checkpoint within the R&D workflow, ensuring that samples and deliverables are validated against client requirements before final approval and reducing avoidable rework and quality escalations.

title: Senior SQA Engineer (Supplier Technical Support)
description:
****New Supplier Development \& Technical Onboarding****
* Serve as the primary technical interface and resident expert at new supplier sites during the launch and qualification phases of new programmes.
* Lead on\-site technical readiness assessments and gap analyses against IATF 16949, APQP, and customer\-specific requirements (CSRs).
* Drive PPAP submission quality by coaching suppliers through Part Submission Warrant (PSW), process flow, PFMEA, control plans, and MSA.
* Establish and validate manufacturing process capability (Cpk/Ppk) and oversee first\-off and first\-article inspection activities.
* Develop and execute structured supplier onboarding programmes aligned to internal quality gates and product launch milestones.


****Hands\-On Technical Training \& Knowledge Transfer****
* Deliver applied, shop\-floor\-based training in core automotive quality systems: APQP, FMEA (AIAG\-VDA), Control Plans, SPC, MSA, and 8D problem\-solving.
* Train supplier personnel in product\-specific technical requirements including drawing interpretation, GD\&T, material specifications, and functional performance criteria.
* Design and facilitate workshops tailored to the supplier's technology base — with particular depth in electronics and PCBA: SMT processes, soldering quality, IPC standards, AOI/AXI interpretation, and ESD control.
* Mentor supplier quality engineers and technicians in root cause analysis tools (Ishikawa, 5\-Why, Is/Is\-Not, Shainin) and corrective action disciplines.
* Build internal supplier capability in layered process audits (LPA) and mistake\-proofing (poka\-yoke) methodologies.


****Electronics \& PCBA Technical Specialisation****
* Provide expert technical oversight at electronics and PCBA suppliers covering SMT, wave soldering, selective soldering, and through\-hole assembly processes.
* Assess and validate soldering quality against IPC\-A\-610 (Acceptability of Electronic Assemblies) and IPC\-J\-STD\-001 standards; coach supplier inspection teams in correct application.
* Evaluate bare PCB suppliers for compliance with IPC\-6012 / IPC\-A\-600 and review first article inspection of boards including impedance, via integrity, and surface finish.
* Review and validate electronic PFMEA and control plans for critical failure modes: solder bridges, opens, tombstoning, cold joints, pad cratering, and component orientation.
* Support qualification of new solder pastes, fluxes, and process chemistries; oversee SPC implementation on key process parameters (reflow profile, paste deposit, AOI escape rate).
* Drive appropriate use of automated optical inspection (AOI), automated X\-ray inspection (AXI/3D\-CT), and in\-circuit test (ICT) within supplier quality gates.
* Assess electrostatic discharge (ESD) controls, traceability, and handling procedures in line with ANSI/ESD S20\.20 requirements.
* Evaluate conformal coating processes (acrylic, silicone, polyurethane) for automotive environmental requirements including humidity, thermal cycling, and vibration resistance.
* Review component qualification evidence and manage supplier response to obsolescence, counterfeiting risk (AS6081\), and counterfeit avoidance controls.
* Support suppliers in establishing or strengthening quality management systems compliant with IATF 16949 and ISO 9001\.
* Conduct and lead formal second\-party audits including System, Process, and Product audits with documented findings and corrective action follow\-through.
* Identify systemic process risks and develop targeted improvement plans using lean and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives at supplier sites using structured problem\-solving and data\-driven approaches.


****Stakeholder Interface \& Reporting****
* Act as the primary liaison between the supplier site team and internal commodity, programme, and engineering stakeholders.
* Provide structured written progress reports, site visit summaries, and supplier scorecards to SQA leadership.
* Escalate product or process concerns with urgency and recommended containment actions.
* Participate in cross\-functional team (CFT) reviews, supplier business reviews, and APQP gate reviews.

title: Quality and Reliability Manager – Memory Products
description:
Quality and Reliability Manager Memory Products
 



  





**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Onsite
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 12 \- 18 Years
 



  





**Industry:** 
 Semiconductor / ATMP / OSAT / Memory Products
 



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 We are looking for a Quality and Reliability Manager to lead product\-quality, package\-reliability and qualification activities for memory products in a high\-volume semiconductor assembly and test environment.
 



 The role will own reliability strategy, qualification execution, product\-health monitoring, failure analysis and corrective\-action closure for DRAM, NAND and related memory products. The position requires strong semiconductor product\-quality knowledge and experience working across packaging, assembly, test, product engineering, manufacturing and customer\-quality functions.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead quality and reliability engineering for semiconductor memory products and package technologies.
* Develop product\- and package\-qualification strategies aligned with JEDEC and customer requirements.
* Define reliability test plans, qualification matrices, sample sizes, acceptance criteria and release requirements.
* Manage reliability testing, including HTOL, HAST/uHAST, temperature cycling, MSL and high\-temperature storage.
* Review qualification results and approve products, packages, materials and process changes for manufacturing release.
* Monitor product\-health, reliability, yield, defect and quality indicators during high\-volume manufacturing.
* Lead investigation of reliability failures, manufacturing excursions, customer returns and field\-quality issues.
* Coordinate electrical and physical failure analysis to identify package\-, process\-, material\- and device\-related causes.
* Drive root\-cause analysis, containment, corrective action and recurrence\-prevention activities.
* Partner with package, product, process, test and equipment engineers during NPI and production ramp\-up.
* Assess reliability risks associated with material, equipment, supplier, process and package changes.
* Establish reliability\-monitoring plans and early\-warning mechanisms for abnormal product trends.
* Support supplier qualification and improvement programs for substrates, leadframes, mold compounds and other materials.
* Lead 8D, CAPA, FMEA and risk\-assessment activities for product\-quality and reliability issues.
* Prepare qualification reports, reliability summaries, risk assessments and customer\-facing technical documentation.
* Support customer audits, quality reviews and technical discussions related to product and package reliability.
* Build and develop the quality and reliability engineering team.
* Ensure laboratory methods, equipment and records comply with internal and industry requirements.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor s or Master s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Materials, Physics, Mechanical, Microelectronics Engineering or a related discipline.
* 12 18 years of semiconductor quality, product reliability, package reliability or qualification experience.
* At least 4 6 years of experience managing quality, reliability or failure\-analysis engineers.
* Strong experience with semiconductor assembly, packaging and test operations.
* Knowledge of DRAM, NAND, NOR or other memory\-product reliability is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing product and package qualification programs.
* Hands\-on knowledge of accelerated reliability testing and failure mechanisms.
* Experience investigating qualification failures, manufacturing excursions and customer complaints.
* Strong understanding of statistical data analysis, quality systems and risk\-management methodologies.
* Ability to support global teams and manufacturing escalations in a 24 7 production environment.



 Technical Skills Memory Product Quality
 


* DRAM and NAND product quality
* Non\-volatile memory reliability
* Memory\-package qualification
* Product\-health monitoring
* Yield and defect analysis
* Product\-change qualification
* Customer\-quality management
* Manufacturing\-quality controls
* Field\-return analysis
* Product lifecycle quality



 Reliability Testing
 


* High\-Temperature Operating Life
* Highly Accelerated Stress Test
* Unbiased HAST
* Temperature Cycling
* Thermal Shock
* Moisture Sensitivity Level
* Preconditioning
* High\-Temperature Storage Life
* Low\-Temperature Storage
* Board\-Level Reliability
* Mechanical and environmental testing



 Package Reliability
 


* Die\-attach integrity
* Wire\-bond reliability
* Intermetallic formation
* Delamination
* Package cracking
* Mold\-compound and substrate interaction
* Solder\-joint reliability
* Package warpage
* Electromigration and corrosion
* Thermal and mechanical stress
* Multi\-die and stacked\-die package reliability



 Failure Analysis
 


* Electrical failure analysis
* Optical microscopy
* X\-ray inspection
* Scanning Acoustic Microscopy
* Decapsulation
* Cross\-section analysis
* SEM/EDS
* Dye\-and\-pry analysis
* Thermal analysis
* Fault isolation
* Failure\-mechanism identification



 Quality and Statistical Tools
 


* 8D problem\-solving
* Root\-cause analysis
* CAPA
* FMEA
* Fault Tree Analysis
* Design of Experiments
* Statistical Process Control
* Process Capability Analysis
* Measurement System Analysis
* Weibull and reliability\-data analysis
* JMP, Minitab or equivalent software



 Standards and Compliance
 


* JEDEC reliability standards
* ISO 9001
* IATF 16949
* AEC\-Q100 awareness
* VDA 6\.3
* Customer\-specific quality requirements
* Change\-control and qualification requirements



 Leadership Responsibilities
 


* Build and lead a strong product\-quality and reliability engineering organization.
* Assign ownership across qualification, reliability monitoring, failure analysis and customer\-quality activities.
* Establish technical review, escalation and corrective\-action mechanisms.
* Develop engineers through mentoring, technical training and competency planning.
* Coordinate resources during NPI, qualification, production ramp and critical quality incidents.
* Establish quality and reliability dashboards for senior\-management review.
* Promote a culture of technical discipline, prevention and continuous improvement.



 Key Performance Indicators
 



**The Position Will Be Responsible For Improving** 



* Qualification success rate
* Product and package reliability
* Customer complaint and return rate
* Reliability failure rate
* Corrective\-action closure time
* Repeat\-issue prevention
* Product yield and defect performance
* NPI and manufacturing\-release readiness
* Supplier\-material quality
* Audit and quality\-system compliance

**an AI\-powered voice automation platform is Looking for:**
**Software QA (Quality Assurance)******
**Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for a life\-critical voice AI platform: automated welfare and emergency\-adjacent calling where an undetected defect can mean a vulnerable person is not reached. Testing here is a safety function, not a formality.
* Perform manual testing (functional, regression, exploratory, usability) and contribute to automated testing across web dashboards, REST and gRPC APIs, and cloud\-hosted services.
* Perform regression, smoke, sanity, and end\-to\-end testing across releases on both staging and production.
* Validate AI\-driven behaviour end to end: speech\-to\-text transcription accuracy against recorded audio fixtures, LLM agent responses and prompt regression, tool and action invocation correctness, turn\-taking and barge\-in behaviour, answering\-machine detection, text\-to\-speech output, and call\-outcome extraction. This means testing non\-deterministic systems: designing tolerance\-based assertions and fixture\-driven suites rather than exact\-match checks, and running against recorded audio and transcripts instead of live vendor calls.
* Conduct API testing across REST and gRPC surfaces using Postman, Bruno, or equivalent, and build contract tests derived from API and schema definitions so that a contract change is caught by a failing test rather than by a customer.
* Own security testing as part of the same role, not as a separate track: write and run test cases against the OWASP API Top 10 (broken object\-level authorization, broken authentication, excessive data exposure, mass assignment, missing rate limiting), and triage the automated security gates in CI (dependency vulnerability scanning, container image scanning, secret scanning, license checks).
* Test multi\-tenant isolation and access control as a first\-class scenario: verify every tenant\-scoped path enforces organisation isolation and role and permission gates, and that no endpoint, filter, or export can return another tenant''''s data.
* Validate data privacy controls: PII redaction in call recordings and transcripts, data subject access and erasure requests, retention windows, and consent, opt\-out, and do\-not\-call handling across voice and SMS.
* Collaborate closely with Developers, Product, and AI Engineers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria, including an explicit security acceptance criterion for any feature touching tenant data, credentials, or telephony.
* Identify, reproduce, document, and track defects in Jira with evidence a developer can act on without a follow\-up call: logs, call identifiers, request and response payloads, screenshots, and audio where relevant.
* Maintain an incident\-to\-test register so that every production incident is closed only once a test exists that would catch it again.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives.
* Contribute to and help maintain the automated suites (Playwright end\-to\-end, Vitest component tests, Go service tests) in GitHub Actions, keeping them fast, stable, and trusted.
* Ensure compliance with security, data privacy, and performance standards, and produce the test evidence that supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, and Australian Privacy Act and APP obligations, including verifying that audit logging is complete and tamper\-evident.
* Validate performance and resilience: concurrent call capacity, campaign throughput, API latency budgets, and correct degradation when an upstream telephony or model provider is slow or unavailable.
* Create and maintain test documentation, reports, and metrics that measure product quality, testing coverage, and security posture.
* Support release validation and post\-deployment monitoring: production smoke tests, watching logs, dashboards, and alerts after a deploy, and driving live issues to root cause with engineering.


**Requirements**
* 4\+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, including hands\-on exposure to security testing or a demonstrated appetite to own it with senior support.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and QA methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of manual testing methodologies, test case design techniques (boundary value, equivalence partitioning, decision tables, state transition), and the bug lifecycle.
* Working knowledge of automation testing frameworks (Playwright preferred Cypress, Selenium, or similar acceptable).
* Experience with API testing tools (Postman, Bruno, RestAssured, or similar) and basic scripting (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Go preferred).
* Practical understanding of web and API security fundamentals: authentication versus authorization, token and session handling, the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Top 10, secrets handling, and TLS basics.
* SQL competence for test data setup and result verification comfortable reading a database schema and querying it directly.
* Familiarity with bug tracking and test management tools (Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, ClickUp, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git, pull request workflows, and reading a diff to scope regression risk.
* Understanding of Agile methodologies.
* Strong command of written and spoken English.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.


**Nice\-to\-Haves**
* Experience testing AI/ML\-integrated systems: validating model predictions, handling non\-deterministic outputs, prompt testing and regression for LLMs, and evaluation harnesses.
* Voice or telephony testing experience: SIP, Twilio or similar carriers, IVR and call flows, call state machines, or audio quality assessment.
* Hands\-on experience building automation frameworks and scripting (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, or Java).
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar.
* Performance and load testing experience using k6, JMeter, LoadRunner, or similar.
* Hands\-on security testing experience: Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP, dependency and container scanning (Trivy, Snyk, Dependabot), static analysis, and CVE triage and prioritisation.
* Understanding of data testing concepts (ETL validation, database testing with SQL, data integrity checks).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and with Docker\-based local and CI test environments.
* Working awareness of SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or the Australian Privacy Act 1988 and the Australian Privacy Principles.
* Exposure to test data management in AI/ML environments, including synthetic and de\-identified datasets.

description:
We are looking for an experienced and highly responsible
 **Quality Assurance Manager** 
 to lead and maintain the Quality Management System for our precision/critical aerospace component manufacturing operations.
 



 The candidate will be responsible for ensuring compliance with
 **AS9100, applicable ISO requirements, customer\-specific requirements, statutory/regulatory requirements, and applicable special\-process/NADCAP requirements** 
 . The QA Manager will drive a strong quality culture across the organization and work closely with Engineering, Production, Supply Chain, PPC, and customers.
 


 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
 
**1\. Quality Management System (QMS)** 



* Establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve the Quality Management System in accordance with AS9100 requirements.
* Ensure all manufacturing and support processes operate according to approved procedures, specifications, drawings, and customer requirements.
* Maintain QMS documentation, procedures, quality manuals, forms, records, and documented information.
* Ensure effective document and revision control throughout the organization.
* Monitor QMS performance and report key quality indicators to top management.



**2\. AS9100 \& Aerospace Compliance** 



* Lead the organization in maintaining AS9100 certification and audit readiness.
* Coordinate certification, surveillance, customer, regulatory, and internal audits.
* Ensure compliance with customer\-specific aerospace quality requirements.
* Support applicable NADCAP/special\-process compliance and supplier approvals.
* Ensure effective implementation of product safety, counterfeit\-part prevention, configuration management, and risk\-based controls.



**3\. Internal \& External Audits** 



* Develop and manage the annual internal audit program.
* Conduct process, system, product, and compliance audits.
* Coordinate external certification and customer audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit findings and non\-conformities.
* Verify effectiveness of corrective actions.



**4\. Non\-Conformance \& Corrective Action** 



* Manage NCR/NCRB, CAPA, deviation, concession, and corrective\-action processes.
* Lead structured root\-cause analysis using methodologies such as 5\-Why, Fishbone, 8D, and other appropriate problem\-solving tools.
* Ensure containment actions are implemented immediately for critical quality issues.
* Monitor recurring defects and drive permanent corrective and preventive actions.
* Coordinate customer complaints and ensure timely investigation and response.



**5\. New Product Development \& Quality Planning** 



* Participate in contract review, feasibility review, and new product introduction (NPI).
* Support preparation and review of process flow, PFMEA, Control Plans, inspection plans, and quality requirements.
* Coordinate First Article Inspection (FAI) requirements, including AS9102 where contractually applicable.
* Ensure customer and drawing requirements are correctly translated into manufacturing and inspection controls.



**6\. Manufacturing Quality Assurance** 



* Ensure effective controls for incoming, in\-process, and final product verification.
* Ensure proper identification, traceability, preservation, and status control of aerospace components.
* Monitor manufacturing quality performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Ensure non\-conforming material is properly identified, segregated, controlled, and dispositioned by authorized personnel.
* Ensure critical characteristics and key characteristics are adequately controlled.



**7\. Supplier Quality** 



* Establish supplier quality requirements and supplier approval criteria.
* Participate in supplier evaluation, qualification, audits, and performance monitoring.
* Monitor supplier rejection, SCAR, delivery quality, and corrective actions.
* Ensure outsourced processes and special\-process suppliers meet customer and aerospace requirements.
* Coordinate with Procurement and Engineering for supplier development.



**8\. Metrology \& Calibration** 



* Ensure inspection and measuring equipment is properly controlled and calibrated.
* Monitor calibration schedules and traceability of measurement standards.
* Ensure appropriate measurement methods, gauges, CMM programs, and inspection equipment are available.
* Support Measurement System Analysis (MSA) and Gauge R\&R where applicable.



**9\. Customer Quality Management** 



* Act as a key quality contact for aerospace customers.
* Coordinate customer complaints, quality concerns, corrective actions, and technical quality discussions.
* Prepare and submit 8D/CAPA responses within agreed timelines.
* Support customer audits, source inspections, FAI reviews, and quality meetings.
* Monitor customer scorecards and initiate improvement actions where required.



**10\. Quality Performance \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Establish and monitor quality KPIs such as rejection rate, scrap, rework, customer complaints, supplier PPM, internal PPM, COPQ, audit findings, and CAPA closure.
* Conduct trend analysis and initiate improvement projects.
* Drive defect prevention rather than dependence on final inspection.
* Promote Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma, mistake\-proofing, and continuous\-improvement practices where appropriate.



**11\. Management Review \& Risk Management** 



* Prepare quality data and reports for Management Review Meetings.
* Identify quality\-related risks and opportunities and ensure appropriate mitigation plans.
* Monitor effectiveness of actions arising from management reviews, audits, customer feedback, and risk assessments.
* Escalate significant product safety, compliance, and customer\-quality risks to top management.



**12\. Team Leadership** 



* Lead, develop, and mentor the QA/QC team.
* Define responsibilities and competency requirements for quality personnel.
* Identify training needs and ensure appropriate technical and QMS training.
* Develop a culture where quality personnel have the authority to raise concerns and stop or hold processes/products when requirements are not met.


 Preferred Qualification \& Experience
 * Preferably
 **8–15 years of experience** 
 in Quality Assurance within aerospace, aviation, precision engineering, automotive, medical device, or other critical manufacturing industries.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a managerial/leadership quality role preferred.
* Strong practical knowledge of
 **AS9100** 
 and ISO 9001\.
* Experience with aerospace customer audits and certification audits.
* Knowledge of
 **AS9102 FAI** 
 , PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, CAPA, 8D, RCA, and risk management.
* Understanding of NADCAP and aerospace special processes is highly desirable.
* Experience in precision CNC machining and critical component manufacturing is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of GD\&T, engineering drawings, inspection methods, CMM, and metrology is desirable.
* AS9100 Internal Auditor/Lead Auditor qualification will be an advantage.


 Key Skills
 
 Strong leadership and communication skills, analytical problem\-solving ability, customer handling, audit management, root\-cause analysis, documentation discipline, technical drawing interpretation, cross\-functional coordination, and a strong commitment to aerospace product quality and safety.
 


 Reporting
 
**Reports To:** 
 Head of Quality / Plant Head / COO / Top Management, depending on organizational structure.
 


* The QA Manager must have sufficient organizational authority and independence to escalate quality and product\-safety concerns without being influenced by production or delivery pressures.

 The QA Engineer will be part of a high\-performance, feature\-driven QA team responsible for building and testing complex Salesforce Core solutions. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of solving technical challenges, taking ownership of quality objectives, and driving testing excellence throughout the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) within an Agile framework.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Requirements Analysis: Analyze business, functional, and technical specifications for Salesforce Core (Sales Cloud) solutions.
* Test Planning \& Design: Create comprehensive test cases and scenarios in JIRA/Zephyr to ensure full requirements coverage.
* Test Execution: Execute planned test cases across desktop, mobile, and tablet environments, ensuring rigorous validation.
* Integration Testing: Conduct rigorous testing for third\-party services and external components within the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Defect Management: Log detailed bug reports in tracking systems, manage the defect lifecycle, and perform thorough retesting and verification of fixes.
* Collaboration \& Agile Participation: Actively participate in daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, and brainstorming sessions to address technical issues and quality risks.
* Estimation \& Reporting: Provide accurate effort estimations for tasks and maintain clear, consistent test results and quality status reporting for stakeholders.
* Process Improvement: Propose and implement enhancements to QA\-related procedures, tools, and systems in collaboration with the QA Lead and Project Managers.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Experience: 3–5 years of professional software testing experience, with at least 3 years specifically focused on testing Salesforce Core (Sales Cloud) platforms.
* Methodologies: Hands\-on experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Tool Proficiency: Experience with JIRA, Confluence, and Zephyr or similar test management tools.
* Core Competencies: Strong background in requirements analysis, test execution, bug lifecycle management, and testing effort estimation.
* Preferred Certification: Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant.
* Soft Skills: Strong team player with high adaptability to dynamic environments and intermediate\-to\-advanced written and verbal English communication skills for effective global collaboration.


 What we offer in return
   

  

* Global Collaboration: The opportunity to work daily with diverse and talented professionals across the globe.
* Off\-the\-Charts Career Growth: Сlear career path and a performance review system, career coaching, training and certifications, mentoring and knowledge sharing.
* Well\-being Is Top Priority: Parental leave, paid time off, comprehensive health and medical plans.
* Real Work\-Life Balance: Dependent on location, we offer remote, in\-office, or hybrid working modes; flexible hours; work\-life balance support on every stage and level.


 Why work for Astound Digital?
   

  

 Whether you’re working directly with our world\-renowned clients or with your Astound colleagues from around the globe, you will shape the future of digital commerce, using emerging technologies and innovative approaches.
   

  

**Grow your career with Astound Digital, and discover exciting opportunities while doing the work you love!**

title: Electrical Quality Engineer
description:
Job Description – Electrical Quality Engineer
 



 Position: Electrical Quality Engineer
 



 Department: Quality / Electrical
 



 Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering
 



 Experience: 2–5 Years
 



 Location: Ahmedabad / Project Sites
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Inspect and verify electrical materials, equipment, and installation work as per approved drawings and specifications.
 



 • Conduct quality inspections and testing of electrical systems, panels, cables, transformers, earthing, lighting, and related equipment.
 



 • Ensure compliance with project specifications, quality standards, and applicable electrical codes.
 



 • Review drawings, BOQs, specifications, and method statements for quality requirements.
 



 • Prepare and maintain inspection reports, checklists, test reports, NCRs, and quality documentation.
 



 • Coordinate with site engineers, contractors, consultants, and clients for quality inspections and approvals.
 



 • Identify quality issues and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
 



 • Monitor workmanship and ensure proper installation practices at project sites.
 



 • Conduct material inspection and verify test certificates and quality documents.
 



 • Support internal and external quality audits.
 



 • Ensure proper documentation and maintain project quality records.
 



 •    Prepare and maintain HOTO (Handing Over \& Taking Over) documentation for completed electrical works.
 



 • Coordinate with site, project, and client teams for smooth project handover.
 



 • Verify that all electrical installations, testing, commissioning, and quality requirements are completed before handover.
 



 • Ensure submission of as\-built drawings, test reports, inspection reports, O\&M manuals, warranties, and other handover documents.
 



 • Conduct joint inspections with the client/consultant and close all pending observations and punch points.
 



 • Maintain proper records of HOTO documents and obtain necessary approvals/sign\-offs.
 



 Required Skills
 



 • Good knowledge of electrical systems, testing, and installation.
 



 • Knowledge of electrical drawings and technical specifications.
 



 • Knowledge of quality control procedures and inspection techniques.
 



 • Familiarity with IS/IEC standards and electrical safety requirements.
 



 • Good communication, coordination, and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Proficiency in MS Office and basic documentation.
 



 • Ability to work independently and at project sites.
 



 Preferred
 



 • Experience in Electrical EPC / MEP / Industrial Projects.
 



 • Knowledge of QA/QC documentation and NCR/CAPA procedures.
 



 • Experience in handling client/consultant inspections.
